jobs.title: English to German (Germany or Switzerland) Linguist & Copy Editor for Product, Marketing & UI Content
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As an English-to-German linguist and copy editor, you will deliver accurate, polished, and audience-appropriate localized content while meeting project deadlines and quality expectations. Your responsibilities will include: Translate content from US English into German for Germany (de-DE) and/or Switzerland (de-CH), ensuring linguistic accuracy, natural phrasing, and cultural relevance. Copy-edit and refine German-language content to improve clarity, readability, consistency, tone, and overall quality. Perform machine translation post-editing (MTPE), correcting errors and ensuring that machine-generated translations meet professional standards. Work across a variety of content types, including marketing materials, product content, user interface text, customer support resources, informational content, and light legal documentation. Use computer-assisted translation (CAT) tools and the client's designated translation platform to manage assignments and maintain consistency. Handle an expected volume of more than 5,000 words per week while delivering high-quality work on schedule. Communicate proactively with project stakeholders, respond to feedback, and incorporate revisions as needed. Follow project guidelines, terminology requirements, and quality standards throughout the localization process. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced English-to-German language professional with excellent linguistic judgment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced localization environment. Candidates should meet one of the following experience and education pathways and demonstrate the following qualifications: Native-level proficiency in German, specifically for Germany (de-DE) and/or Switzerland (de-CH). Excellent command of US English (en-US), with the ability to understand source content accurately and convey its intended meaning in German. At least 2 years of professional translation experience and a degree in Translation, Linguistics, or a related field; alternatively, at least 5 years of professional translation experience without a formal translation degree. Demonstrated experience translating from English into German across multiple content types, including marketing, product, UI, support, and informational materials. Practical experience using computer-assisted translation (CAT) tools. Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate, consistent, high-quality translations. Strong time-management skills and the ability to meet deadlines while managing a substantial weekly workload. Excellent communication skills, responsiveness, reliability, and a willingness to receive and implement feedback. Ability to work independently as a freelance professional while collaborating effectively with a global team. Benefits: Fully remote freelance opportunity, with work available internationally. Ongoing project with the potential to establish a long-term professional partnership. Expected workload of 5,000+ words per week. Opportunity to contribute to high-visibility international projects for a leading multinational company. Access to a global network of linguists and language professionals. Ongoing project support and collaboration throughout assignments. Training provided during onboarding for the client-specific CAT tool. Flexible freelance working arrangements, subject to project deadlines and volume requirements.

You will collaborate closely with customer IT departments and internal product, development, and sales teams to ensure smooth implementations and effective ongoing support. The position combines technical problem-solving, customer relationship management, and operational coordination in the fast-evolving sports betting and esports industries. It is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with digital products, learning new technologies, and helping customers achieve their goals. If you are proactive, detail-oriented, and motivated by solving technical challenges in an international environment, this role offers an opportunity to grow your expertise. Manage multiple customer relationships: Support customers across different locations, balancing competing priorities while maintaining responsive and professional communication. Develop technical expertise: Stay informed about sportsbook products, digital technologies, and the esports ecosystem to provide increasingly effective customer guidance. Travel when required: Be willing to travel to support customer needs, integrations, or other business activities. Requirements Industry knowledge: Understanding of the sports betting industry and familiarity with how sportsbook products and platforms operate. jobs.title: Graphic Designer (Freelance)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will develop high-quality visual assets for paid social advertising campaigns, collaborating with the team to transform creative ideas into effective designs that align with campaign objectives and performance metrics. Participate actively in the entire creative process, from brainstorming and ideation to design execution and final delivery. Create engaging, high-quality visual assets for diverse advertising concepts across Meta and TikTok. Interpret creative briefs and collaborate with team members to understand design requirements, project objectives, and deadlines. Produce polished, pixel-perfect designs with exceptional attention to detail, typography, composition, and visual aesthetics. Apply design best practices to ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality across creative deliverables. Provide technical guidance on file organization, asset management, and digital design standards. Contribute creative ideas and propose innovative solutions to improve advertising concepts and campaign effectiveness. Use an understanding of paid social performance and audience engagement to inform design decisions and support campaign KPIs. Stay informed about emerging visual trends, social media formats, and creative approaches relevant to digital advertising. Requirements: You are a detail-oriented designer with strong visual storytelling skills, proven experience creating paid social advertisements, and the ability to combine creativity with a performance-focused mindset. You work independently, welcome feedback, and proactively contribute ideas that improve creative outcomes. Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator. Practical experience working with Figma. Proven experience designing creative assets for paid social advertising campaigns. A strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality visual design, creativity, and an understanding of digital advertising. A strong interest in the startup ecosystem, with an understanding of copywriting principles, market dynamics, and emerging trends. Experience working with FinTech clients is a significant advantage. A solution-oriented mindset, with the confidence to influence creative decisions and recommend improvements based on KPIs and social media performance metrics. Exceptional attention to detail, including typography, visual consistency, and technical accuracy. Strong work ethic, initiative, adaptability, and a willingness to learn. The ability to manage tasks independently, collaborate effectively, and deliver quality work within agreed deadlines. A genuine passion for social media, creative experimentation, and producing outstanding digital advertising content. Benefits: Fully remote work: Work from anywhere in the world. Freelance flexibility: Independent contractor engagement offering flexibility in how you organize your work. Creative ownership: Contribute throughout the creative process, from brainstorming to final execution. Collaborative environment: Work closely with a team focused on creative innovation and digital advertising. Performance-driven projects: Create advertising assets designed to support campaign engagement and measurable results. Startup experience: Contribute to an innovative environment focused on transforming digital advertising production. Portfolio development: Build experience across creative concepts and paid social campaigns on Meta and TikTok. Compensation and additional benefits: No specific salary range or additional benefits are stated in the job description.

jobs.title: Freelance Full-Stack Developer | Django | AI Products | Python & LLM Integration
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will contribute to the full development lifecycle, from implementing product features to integrating AI services and improving the codebase, working independently while collaborating closely with a small, senior team. Build, maintain, and extend full-stack features for an AI-powered product, primarily using Django and Python. Develop lightweight frontend interfaces using HTMX, Alpine.js, and Tailwind CSS. Integrate third-party APIs, AI services, and large language model providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and OpenRouter. Connect marketing data sources and incorporate relevant data into product functionality. Write clean, reliable, maintainable Python code and contribute to a well-structured, evolving codebase. Apply modern AI-assisted development tools and workflows to accelerate implementation while maintaining strong engineering standards. Manage your workload independently, communicate progress clearly, and collaborate effectively with a remote team. Contribute technical insights, suggest improvements, and help shape product development decisions. Support the continued evolution of the platform by delivering features aligned with its roadmap and user needs. Requirements: You are an experienced full-stack developer who combines strong Python and Django expertise with practical experience building AI-powered applications. You are comfortable working autonomously, using modern development tools, and contributing ideas in a collaborative environment. At least five years of hands-on full-stack development experience, preferably with Django as your primary framework. Strong Python programming skills and a proven track record of building and shipping production-ready products. Experience developing AI-powered applications using technologies such as LangChain, LangSmith, OpenAI APIs, OpenRouter, or Anthropic APIs. Familiarity with Docker and confident use of Git for version control and collaborative development. A balanced approach to software development that combines sound engineering fundamentals with modern AI-assisted workflows. Practical experience or familiarity with AI development tools such as Cursor, Codex, and Claude Code, with the ability to explain how you use them in your daily work. Strong written and spoken English, as English is the primary working language. The ability to work independently, manage priorities, communicate clearly, and contribute ideas proactively. Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Azure, CI/CD, or DevOps pipelines is a plus. Frontend development skills and a strong eye for UI design and user experience are advantageous. German language skills are a plus, particularly for candidates who also communicate fluently in English. Application requirement: You must submit both your CV and a two-minute introductory video. The video should explain who you are, why you are interested in the role, and how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work. It can be recorded using Loom, a phone, or another tool; professional production quality is not expected. Benefits: Flexible freelance engagement: Approximately 60 hours per month, equivalent to around 15 hours per week. Fully remote work: Work from anywhere in the world. Independent contractor arrangement: A freelance engagement offering flexibility and autonomy. Meaningful ownership: Take responsibility for the features you build and contribute ideas that influence the product. Experienced team: Collaborate with a small, senior team and benefit from short decision-making paths. AI product development: Work on a live, evolving AI platform with a clear roadmap and ambitious goals. Technical freedom: Bring your experience, explore solutions, and help shape how the product is developed. Flexible working style: Manage your workload independently within a collaborative remote environment.

jobs.title: Enablement Manager, Public Sector
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Build and improve onboarding programs: Develop and continuously refine the Public Sector onboarding experience, refreshing core learning modules within seven days of new-hire confirmation and helping accelerate new seller readiness by 25–30%. Maintain sales playbooks and content: Keep sales messaging, playbooks, competitive materials, discovery resources, and procurement guidance current. Update core content within three business days when leadership identifies messaging gaps, changing procurement requirements, or recurring objections. Deliver targeted training: Create and deliver sector-specific training and micro-enablement resources, including one-pagers, talk tracks, practical scenarios, and short practice sessions, within 72 hours of identified execution gaps. Strengthen sales execution: Partner with sales managers to reinforce qualification standards, evaluation planning, procurement-path mapping, stakeholder engagement, multithreading, and effective deal management. Manage sales enablement systems: Maintain an organized, accessible content hub, such as Dock, and drive adoption above 90%, ensuring sellers can quickly find reliable and relevant resources. Measure program effectiveness: Track onboarding progress, content adoption, and early-funnel performance. Analyze results, identify execution gaps, and recommend improvements that support stronger deal quality, consistency, and forecast accuracy. jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Lead based in Germany. As a Product Lead, you will shape product strategy and drive the development of innovative solutions in the fast-paced iGaming industry. You will oversee product roadmaps, guide strategic prioritization, and ensure that product initiatives deliver measurable business value. In this leadership role, you will mentor and develop Product Managers while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Working closely with business, technical, and other cross-functional teams, you will translate customer needs and market opportunities into impactful product experiences. You will leverage analytics, experimentation, and competitive insights to inform decisions and optimize product performance. This fully remote opportunity offers an international environment where strategic thinking, data-driven execution, and strong leadership contribute directly to sustainable business growth. Accountabilities:: Define and execute product strategies aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and long-term growth opportunities. Lead, mentor, and develop Product Managers, encouraging ownership, collaboration, and continuous professional development. Oversee product roadmap planning, prioritization, and execution across multiple initiatives, ensuring alignment with strategic goals. Establish and continuously improve product management processes to strengthen collaboration between business and technical teams. Drive data-informed decision-making through product analytics, performance metrics, A/B testing, and experimentation. Identify opportunities for product optimization by analyzing customer insights, market trends, and competitive intelligence. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver effective product solutions. Monitor product performance against business objectives, identify potential risks, and implement improvements to maximize results. Translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, ensuring product initiatives deliver measurable impact and support business growth. Requirements: Proven experience in a Product Lead, Group Product Manager, Head of Product, or similar product leadership role. Strong product management experience within the iGaming industry, with an understanding of its market dynamics and business models. Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop Product Managers while building high-performing, collaborative teams. Solid expertise in product strategy, roadmap development, prioritization, and end-to-end product execution. Strong analytical skills, including experience with product metrics, A/B testing, experimentation, and hypothesis validation. Experience managing complex, cross-functional initiatives and aligning diverse stakeholders around shared objectives. Ability to translate business goals, customer needs, and market insights into clear product strategies and actionable initiatives. A strategic mindset combined with strong execution capabilities, sound judgment, and effective problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, leadership, and decision-making abilities, with a proactive, results-oriented approach. The ability to thrive in a dynamic, international, and fully remote working environment. Benefits: Fully remote work: Work remotely within the supported locations, with flexibility in your working environment. Full-time employment: Take on a leadership role with the opportunity to influence product strategy and business performance. Professional development: Access to training compensation to support ongoing learning and career growth. Home office assistance: Financial support for setting up a comfortable and productive remote workspace. Mental health support: Access to resources designed to support employee well-being. jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Launch and manage in-app advertising campaigns, learning to set up campaigns from scratch and target audiences across European Tier 1 and Tier 2 markets. Prepare, organize, and analyze campaign data using tools such as Unity Ads, Binom, Tableau, Excel, and Google Sheets. Research target markets, investigate local audience preferences, and use competitive intelligence and spy tools to identify successful advertising approaches. Strong research skills and curiosity about different markets, cultures, and consumer behavior. A proactive, solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to investigate questions independently, take initiative, and seek practical answers. A willingness to learn new advertising platforms, analytical tools, and campaign optimization techniques in a fast-paced, international environment. Experience with teaser advertising networks is a plus, as their campaign structures can be similar to in-app advertising. jobs.title: IT Support Analyst – Application Operations
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Analyze recurring IT incidents, identify root causes, and implement sustainable corrective measures to improve application reliability and reduce service disruptions. Investigate, reproduce, and troubleshoot application errors in test environments, collaborating with developers, software vendors, and internal technical teams to resolve issues efficiently. Monitor banking applications and IT systems, optimize existing monitoring processes, and identify opportunities for automation and operational improvements. Configure and administer banking applications, particularly OpenLease, including system settings, workflows, and user roles according to business requirements. Provide first- and second-level application support, contributing to major incident management through fault diagnosis, prioritization, resolution coordination, and stakeholder communication. Process user access requests and maintain permissions in accordance with internal security policies and access management standards. Document technical investigations, workarounds, configuration changes, and incident resolutions while maintaining accurate and up-to-date knowledge base documentation. Support continuous improvement initiatives across application operations, incident management, monitoring, and IT service delivery. Requirements Previous experience in IT application support, application operations, or a similar role, ideally within a complex enterprise or financial services environment. Solid understanding of incident management, problem management, troubleshooting methodologies, and IT service management processes. Experience using IT service management and documentation tools, particularly Jira and Confluence. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex application issues systematically and develop practical, long-term solutions. Technical understanding of application environments, system configurations, monitoring processes, and software troubleshooting. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and external software providers. Ability to learn quickly, adapt to complex banking applications, and manage competing priorities in a structured and solution-oriented manner. Very good German and English communication skills, both written and spoken. Experience with monitoring tools, particularly Splunk, and basic SQL knowledge for troubleshooting and data analysis are advantageous. Familiarity with banking applications, financial services regulations, and IT security policies is a plus. Benefits Remote work: The original listing advertises a worldwide remote arrangement; confirm location and contractual eligibility for India during the application process. Employment arrangement: Fixed-term employment contract. Start date: As soon as possible. Professional development: Opportunity to deepen your expertise in application operations, enterprise IT support, incident management, and banking technology. Technical exposure: Hands-on experience with business-critical banking applications, monitoring tools, troubleshooting, and cross-functional IT collaboration. Problem-solving and ownership: An opportunity to contribute directly to system stability, operational efficiency, and continuous service improvement. Compensation: Salary and other financial benefits are not specified in the original job description.

jobs.title: Medicare & Health Insurance Outbound Appointment Setting Virtual Assistant
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Conduct outbound calls to existing, previous, and new Medicare leads using client-provided contact lists. Introduce the purpose of each call using approved scripts and determine whether individuals are interested in discussing their Medicare coverage with a licensed insurance representative. Ask appropriate follow-up questions, identify appointment preferences, address routine objections within established guidelines, and schedule qualified appointments. Communicate with seniors using patience, empathy, and clear language, adjusting the pace of conversations and clarifying information when necessary. Follow up with interested prospects who have not yet scheduled appointments and maintain continuity throughout the outreach process. Document questions, objections, concerns, and requests requiring additional attention from the agency. Refer questions about Medicare plans, prescription coverage, eligibility, and insurance benefits to authorized representatives rather than providing unapproved advice. Direct Spanish-language inquiries to the designated bilingual team member. Record call outcomes, contact details, appointment dates, follow-up requests, and other relevant information in Microsoft Excel and the client's designated systems. Maintain accurate, organized lead-tracking spreadsheets and monitor outstanding callbacks and unresolved inquiries. Submit completed call records and appointment information and prepare daily end-of-day reports summarizing call activity, appointments scheduled, and pending tasks. Support seasonal Medicare outreach campaigns during applicable enrollment periods and learn additional approved scripts for future health insurance initiatives. Assist with Covered California appointment-setting campaigns as trained and maintain accurate records when transitioning between outreach campaigns. Use the client's phone and VoIP systems, email and calendar platforms, lead-tracking tools, and appointment scheduling software to complete assigned tasks. Follow documented procedures, agreed service timelines, quality standards, and the terms of the independent contractor engagement. Requirements: Previous experience in phone-based customer service, outbound calling, telemarketing, or a similar client-facing role is required. Excellent spoken and written English, with a clear, professional, and easily understood speaking style. A native or near-native English accent is preferred. Experience setting appointments is strongly preferred, particularly in lead generation, customer outreach, or sales support. Experience communicating with seniors or other individuals who may need additional time, clarification, or reassurance is an advantage. Strong listening, patience, empathy, rapport-building, and conversational communication skills. Ability to follow established scripts while maintaining natural, respectful conversations and handling routine objections professionally. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when recording contact information, call outcomes, appointments, and follow-up requirements. Practical proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including accurate data entry and maintaining structured tracking worksheets. Familiarity with Medicare, health insurance, healthcare services, or insurance-related customer support is preferred. Ability to learn new scripts, follow campaign-specific procedures, and adapt to changing enrollment periods and outreach priorities. Willingness to learn and use Ooma or comparable phone systems, VoIP communication platforms, email and calendar tools, and lead management or appointment scheduling software. Training on the client's system will be provided as needed. Dependability, consistency, coachability, and the ability to manage outbound calling responsibilities independently. jobs.title: GTM Manager Outbound (all genders)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Build and continuously improve an AI-powered outbound sales engine, automating research, lead scoring, prospecting workflows, and performance reporting using tools such as Claude and HubSpot. Identify, research, and prioritize high-value target accounts based on ideal customer profiles, business needs, and potential commercial opportunities. Engage key decision-makers through personalized outreach across multiple channels, including phone calls, LinkedIn, video messages, and industry events. Practical experience using AI-powered workflows to improve sales prospecting, research, personalization, lead qualification, or reporting. Familiarity with CRM platforms, ideally HubSpot, including pipeline tracking, activity management, and performance reporting. Strong copywriting skills, with the ability to create persuasive, personalized cold outreach messages that resonate with business decision-makers. Data-driven mindset and the ability to measure campaign performance, interpret results, and use insights to continuously improve outreach strategies. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence engaging prospects through phone, LinkedIn, video, and in-person events. Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and take ownership of building new processes in an evolving environment. Strong organizational skills and a proactive approach to testing new ideas, learning from results, and documenting effective practices. Conduct client intake and collect essential information regarding accidents, injuries, insurance coverage, employment, and medical history. Request, obtain, review, and organize medical records, medical bills, police reports, insurance records, and other supporting evidence. Maintain regular communication with clients regarding medical treatment, case progress, missing documentation, and upcoming milestones. Coordinate with medical providers, insurance adjusters, opposing counsel, expert witnesses, and other relevant parties. Prepare settlement demand packages, settlement documentation, correspondence, case summaries, and supporting materials. Track medical treatment, insurance coverage, liens, damages, settlement activity, and related case information. Assist with lien resolution by gathering payoff statements and coordinating the necessary documentation. Draft and prepare pleadings, discovery requests and responses, notices, subpoenas, and other litigation documents as required. Support deposition, mediation, hearing, and trial preparation by organizing exhibits, medical records, damages evidence, and litigation materials. Monitor statutes of limitation, court deadlines, discovery schedules, and other important case milestones to ensure timely action. Prepare and submit court filings using applicable electronic filing systems. Maintain accurate, complete, and well-organized digital case files using legal case management and document management platforms. Follow established procedures, documentation standards, and quality requirements while managing multiple cases and competing priorities. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience as a paralegal, lawyer, or attorney. At least 2 years of experience working as a personal injury paralegal for a law firm in the United States. Strong practical knowledge of U.S. plaintiff-side personal injury matters and experience managing cases from intake through settlement. Demonstrated experience obtaining and organizing medical records, medical bills, insurance documentation, and other supporting evidence. Hands-on experience preparing settlement demand packages and supporting settlement processes. Proven ability to communicate directly and professionally with clients, medical providers, insurance companies, attorneys, and other stakeholders. Familiarity with bodily injury claims, insurance coverage, medical treatment documentation, liens, damages assessment, and settlement procedures. Litigation support experience, including drafting pleadings, preparing discovery materials, and assisting with depositions, mediation, or trial preparation. Strong understanding of statutes of limitation, court procedures, and case management deadlines. Excellent legal writing, document preparation, proofreading, and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail. Experience using personal injury case management software or other legal practice management platforms. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 or comparable cloud-based productivity tools. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. A stable employment history, with at least two years of tenure in each previous role. Advanced practical experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini to support professional workflows. Reliable high-speed internet, suitable professional equipment, and a quiet home office. Consistent availability during U.S. business hours and a commitment to a long-term remote position supporting a U.S. law firm. Ability to work independently, manage sensitive information responsibly, prioritize tasks effectively, and maintain high-quality output in a remote environment. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement based in Estonia. Choice of full-time or part-time employment. Opportunity to work with a U.S. law firm handling plaintiff-s

jobs.title: Senior FullStack Developer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead end-to-end full stack development across React-based user interfaces, Node.js backend services, and Web3 integrations. Design, develop, and scale decentralized applications that integrate blockchain wallets, decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols, and on-chain data sources. Integrate Web3 libraries, software development kits, third-party packages, and APIs into robust, secure, and reliable product workflows. Architect and implement systems that meet demanding requirements for performance, scalability, security, and interoperability across decentralized ecosystems. Develop and optimize infrastructure capable of processing high volumes of real-time market information, blockchain activity, and other data streams. Take ownership of the entire software development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and production support. Investigate complex production issues, identify root causes, and implement improvements that strengthen system reliability and operational performance. Collaborate with experienced engineers on architectural decisions, technical strategy, and research into emerging technologies relevant to Web3 and decentralized markets. Contribute to the development of advanced trading and market intelligence products, helping transform complex data into intuitive, high-performance user experiences. Maintain high engineering standards through thoughtful technical decisions, quality-focused implementation, and continuous improvement of development practices. Requirements: At least 10 years of professional software development experience, with a strong background in designing, building, and maintaining production-grade applications. A minimum of 3 years of full stack development experience with a substantial focus on Web3 technologies and blockchain-based applications. Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, and Node.js, with the ability to develop and maintain complex frontend and backend systems. Demonstrated experience delivering Web3 applications or integrations to production environments. Hands-on experience integrating blockchain wallets, DeFi protocols, on-chain data sources, and third-party Web3 libraries, packages, or APIs. Proven experience designing and scaling data-intensive systems, particularly those involving real-time processing and high-volume information flows. Strong architectural judgment and a practical understanding of system performance, security, scalability, and reliability. Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, make independent engineering decisions, and take responsibility for production outcomes. Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance rapid delivery against long-term maintainability and technical quality. Fluent English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with experienced engineers in a distributed environment. A high degree of autonomy, accountability, and initiative, along with the ability to manage broad responsibilities in a fast-moving startup. Comfort working in a demanding, execution-focused environment where engineers are expected to take ownership and deliver results with limited supervision. Experience with multi-chain development, particularly across Ethereum and Solana, is an advantage. Familiarity with Prisma, Zod, tRPC, and Fastify is considered a plus. Benefits: Fully remote work: Work remotely from Poland with flexible working hours. Competitive compensation: Annual salary of up to USD 90,000, depending on experience and qualifications. Technical ownership: Significant autonomy in shaping architecture, making engineering decisions, and delivering core product capabilities. Experienced colleagues: Collaborate with a highly skilled, senior-level engineering team in a direct and execution-focused environment. Web3 innovation: Contribute to advanced decentralized applications, market intelligence infrastructure, and next-generation trading technologies. End

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Backend - Protection
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Backend Engineering and Architecture: Design, build, deploy, and maintain robust backend systems, taking ownership of solutions throughout their entire lifecycle. Make architectural decisions regarding service boundaries, integration patterns, and data models to ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Payment Dispute Automation: Develop automation capabilities that help merchants manage payment disputes at scale, including notifications, deadline tracking, evidence collection, and response workflows. Payment Service Provider Integrations: Expand dispute management coverage across the broader payment network by integrating additional payment service providers and ensuring consistent functionality across different platforms. Fraud Prevention Integrations: Collaborate with third-party fraud prevention providers, including Riskified, Forter, Signifyd, and Sift, to build a unified experience for comparing, managing, and switching between fraud solutions. Rules and Signals Engine: Design and implement native risk management capabilities, including velocity rules, blocklists, device fingerprinting, and configurable automation that enables merchants to manage fraud and disputes more effectively. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and other stakeholders to translate merchant challenges into practical technical solutions, prioritizing delivery, customer value, and measurable outcomes. Product Development: Contribute to backend development as the primary focus, while supporting dashboard frontend development when needed to deliver complete product experiences. Quality, Reliability, and Monitoring: Establish and maintain high engineering standards through testing, code reviews, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Ensure that critical dispute and fraud workflows operate reliably, minimizing errors that could result in financial losses for customers. Technical Leadership and Mentoring: Share expertise, mentor colleagues, and raise the team's technical standards through sound engineering practices, thoughtful architectural decisions, and collaborative problem-solving. Engineering Foundations: Help establish team conventions, operational tooling, on-call processes, and development practices as the function grows, balancing foundational improvements with frequent, high-quality product delivery. Requirements: Proven experience owning backend systems end to end, from architecture and development through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance. Strong software engineering and system design skills, with the ability to design scalable backend architectures and make sound technical decisions in evolving environments. Experience building systems from scratch, defining technical approaches, and taking ownership of ambiguous problems without relying on fully established processes. High standards for code quality, testing, reliability, and operational excellence, particularly when developing systems where failures can have significant financial or operational consequences. A proactive, delivery-focused mindset, with a track record of shipping improvements frequently, gathering feedback, and translating ideas into reliable customer-facing functionality. Experience mentoring engineers, supporting colleagues' technical development, or helping establish engineering best practices. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues and balance speed of delivery with long-term system quality. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Engineering and Product stakeholders in a remote, distributed environment. Comfort working in a growing team where requirements, processes, tooling, and operational practices are still evolving. Experience in payments, fraud prevention, risk management, or another technically complex domain is advantageous. Familiarity with card scheme rules,

jobs.title: Product Compliance Counsel
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Product Compliance: Review and approve product specifications for websites and mobile applications, ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and platform policies. Assess risks associated with product features, user journeys, monetization models, and digital service functionality. Participate in product compliance audits and incident response activities. Marketing Compliance: Review advertising materials, promotional campaigns, and marketing communications to ensure compliance with relevant legislation and platform requirements. Advise Marketing teams on consumer protection, advertising standards, promotional claims, and potential legal risks. Support marketing compliance audits and the implementation of corrective actions. Regulatory Monitoring: Monitor legislative and regulatory developments across relevant jurisdictions, particularly in the EU and US. Assess their impact on digital products, marketing practices, and business processes, communicating regulatory updates and supporting the implementation of necessary changes. Sanctions Compliance: Track sanctions-related regulatory developments and support the implementation and maintenance of internal sanctions policies, procedures, and controls. Compliance Awareness and Training: Contribute to the development and delivery of compliance training programs and onboarding materials. Create, maintain, and update internal compliance guidance, practical playbooks, and knowledge resources to promote consistent understanding of regulatory obligations. AI Compliance and Governance: Review AI-enabled products, features, and third-party artificial intelligence integrations to assess compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Support AI-related risk assessments and help implement appropriate governance frameworks and controls. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Marketing, and other internal stakeholders to integrate compliance considerations into product development and operational decision-making, balancing regulatory requirements with business objectives and user experience. Requirements: A bachelor's or master's degree in Law or an equivalent legal qualification. Knowledge of consumer protection legislation in the European Union and the United States, with the ability to assess its implications for digital products and online services. Understanding of marketing and advertising compliance requirements in the EU and US, including promotional claims, digital advertising practices, and consumer-facing communications. Familiarity with European and US digital legislation, regulatory frameworks for technology platforms, and emerging requirements related to artificial intelligence governance. Knowledge of Apple App Store and Google Play guidelines, including platform-specific requirements affecting mobile applications, monetization, and product functionality. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Russian, at a minimum B2 level in both languages. Strong analytical and research capabilities, with the ability to interpret complex legal requirements and translate them into practical guidance for business and technical teams. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify, assess, and communicate compliance risks effectively. Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams in an international, remote-first environment. A proactive, adaptable, and solution-oriented approach, with an interest in digital products, emerging technologies, and evolving regulatory frameworks. Benefits: Fully remote working: Full-time remote work with the flexibility to work from different locations. Competitive compensation: Salary range and initial compensation details shared during the recruitment process and before employment begins. Annual vacation: 28 calendar days of paid vacation per year. Wellness leave: Seven additional wellness days annually to man

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer - Storybook
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Contribute to the Storybook codebase as a core maintainer, helping shape the direction, quality, and long-term sustainability of the platform. Design, develop, and refine APIs that serve end users, addon authors, and other core maintainers, with a strong focus on usability and developer experience. Participate in open-source collaboration by triaging issues, reviewing pull requests, supporting contributors, and writing or reviewing Request for Comments (RFCs). Understand developers’ workflows and challenges, creating or reviewing educational content that helps users adopt new features and get the most out of the platform. Contribute to the ongoing expansion of frontend ecosystem support, helping ensure the platform works effectively across modern frameworks and development environments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an asynchronous, distributed team. Opportunities to participate in developer community activities and speak at conferences. A proven ability to improve business performance metrics related to costs, revenue, payment success, and financial losses, supported by quantifiable results. Strong analytical skills and the ability to independently retrieve and interpret data using SQL or equivalent tools. Paid Traffic Acquisition: Manage campaigns across in-app advertising networks, particularly Unity Ads and Kayzen, while leveraging relevant experience with platforms such as Moloco to identify and scale profitable traffic sources. Budget Management and Scaling: Oversee daily advertising budgets of at least $1,500, optimizing spend allocation and scaling campaigns while maintaining acquisition efficiency and profitability. Campaign Performance Optimization: Monitor key performance indicators, analyze relationships between campaign metrics, and implement optimization strategies to control deposit acquisition costs and improve overall campaign performance. Creative Strategy and Testing: Collaborate with designers to develop distinctive creative concepts and unconventional combinations of advertising creatives and offers. Performance Optimization: Demonstrated ability to optimize deposit acquisition costs, improve campaign profitability, and make informed scaling decisions based on performance data. jobs.title: Web3 Licensing and Regulatory Compliance Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Regulatory Advisory and Client Delivery: Deliver regulatory consulting projects for crypto-asset service providers (CASPs), virtual asset service providers (VASPs), token issuers, and other digital-asset businesses. Support licensing readiness, authorization processes, compliance gap assessments, regulatory reviews, and implementation projects. Licensing and Authorization Support: Assist clients with preparing and coordinating licensing applications, supporting documentation, evidence, stakeholder contributions, and responses to regulatory authorities, particularly across European Union and United Arab Emirates jurisdictions. Compliance Framework Development: Translate regulatory requirements into practical governance frameworks, anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing (CFT) procedures, cybersecurity measures, technology controls, and operational policies tailored to digital-asset business models. Regulatory Gap Assessments: Evaluate existing compliance arrangements against applicable regulatory requirements, identify deficiencies, and develop clear, actionable remediation plans to support licensing and ongoing compliance. Research and Regulatory Monitoring: Monitor evolving Web3 regulations, supervisory expectations, and industry developments across priority jurisdictions, with particular emphasis on the European Union and the United Arab Emirates. Documentation and Reporting: Prepare clear regulatory analyses, compliance reports, application materials, control mappings, and recommendations. Present findings through client workshops and written deliverables, ensuring alignment with project scope, deadlines, and follow-up actions. Internal Methodology and Service Development: Convert regulatory research and client engagement insights into reusable templates, methodologies, knowledge resources, and improved regulatory advisory services. Compliance Technology and Workflow Improvement: Collaborate with cybersecurity, AML, product, and engineering teams to define regulatory requirements, improve compliance tools and workflows, contribute to testing, and ensure solutions reflect applicable regulatory expectations. Continuous Improvement and Market Insights: Use client feedback and market developments to identify new service opportunities, improve delivery consistency, and develop scalable solutions for digital-asset businesses. Requirements Relevant Professional Experience: Two to four years of experience in digital-asset regulatory compliance, financial-services licensing, legal or compliance operations, regulatory consulting, or a related field. Licensing and Authorization Expertise: Practical experience supporting a Web3 licensing or authorization process for a CASP, VASP, token issuer, or similar digital-asset business. Direct experience with the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), VARA, ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA), DFSA, or other European Union or United Arab Emirates regulatory frameworks is particularly valuable. Web3 and Blockchain Knowledge: Practical understanding of blockchain networks, cryptocurrency wallets, custody arrangements, exchanges, digital-asset transfers, token issuance, stablecoins, and common digital-asset business models. Regulatory and Compliance Knowledge: Working knowledge of regulatory requirements relating to corporate governance, operational risk, consumer protection, technology, cybersecurity, and AML/CFT, with the ability to apply these principles to digital-asset businesses. Regulatory Analysis and Documentation: Strong ability to interpret complex regulatory texts, map obligations to appropriate controls, prepare clear documentation, and develop practical compliance recommendations. Project Coordination and Delivery: Excellent organizational skills and the ability to coordinate stakeholders, gather supporting evidence, manage dependencies, track deadlines, and deliver multiple workstreams within agreed project parameters. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative – Enterprise Sales
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Execute structured outbound prospecting campaigns, primarily through cold calls, to generate qualified leads and create new business opportunities across European markets. Research and identify relevant target companies, decision-makers, and key stakeholders, including Executive Assistants, Chief Legal Officers, and IT leaders. Qualify prospects based on business needs and potential fit, and schedule meetings for Account Executives to advance the sales pipeline. Support the preparation and follow-up of customer meetings to ensure effective communication and a smooth handover to the sales team. Maintain accurate and up-to-date prospect information, activity records, and interaction histories in HubSpot CRM. Monitor outreach performance, work toward clearly defined sales targets, and maintain consistent prospecting activity. Share insights and propose improvements to lead generation, messaging, and outbound strategies across different European markets. Collaborate with the wider sales team in an international environment, contributing to a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and high performance. Requirements: Demonstrate native-level or equivalent professional proficiency in English (C1/C2), with excellent spoken and written communication skills. Show a strong interest in sales development, enterprise sales, business development, or outbound prospecting. A demonstrated ability to succeed in a target-driven environment is an advantage. Be comfortable making cold calls, initiating conversations with new prospects, and engaging confidently with stakeholders at different organizational levels. Possess a results-oriented mindset, with the ambition to achieve measurable goals and the discipline to maintain high levels of activity. Demonstrate resilience, persistence, and a positive attitude when handling rejection or navigating challenging prospecting conversations. Have strong research, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to identify relevant accounts and prioritize outreach effectively. Be comfortable working with CRM systems and documenting sales activities accurately; experience with HubSpot is an advantage. Demonstrate initiative, ownership, and a willingness to learn quickly, accept feedback, and take on increasing responsibility. Be motivated by a performance-focused environment that values continuous improvement, professional development, and tangible business outcomes. Additional European language skills are a plus, particularly for engaging prospects across diverse international markets. Benefits: Remote-first flexibility: Work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world, with a high degree of trust, autonomy, and ownership. Competitive compensation: Access transparent, market-oriented, performance-based compensation. Modern technology: Work with a modern sales and technology stack designed to support efficient workflows and measurable impact. International collaboration: Join an ambitious, supportive, and multicultural team with an open feedback culture. Career development: Benefit from learning opportunities, personal development support, and clear career progression pathways. Team connection: Participate in regular team offsites and workations to strengthen collaboration and build relationships. Meaningful impact: Help shape and expand international outbound sales operations across European markets. Growth opportunities: Develop enterprise sales expertise, strengthen your prospecting and stakeholder engagement skills, and build a foundation for future sales career progression.

jobs.title: SAP HCM Consultant (TM, OM & PA)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Configure, maintain, and support SAP HCM modules, specifically Time Management (TM), Organizational Management (OM), and Personnel Administration (PA), ensuring reliable system performance and alignment with business requirements. Analyze business processes and stakeholder needs to recommend, design, and implement effective SAP HCM solutions and system enhancements. Manage and maintain employee master data, organizational structures, personnel administration actions, and related HR processes to support data accuracy and consistency. Configure and optimize Time Management functionalities, including work schedules, absence and attendance management, and quota processing. Support payroll-related integrations with SAP HCM Personnel Administration and Time Management modules, helping ensure accurate and consistent data flows. Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, assess existing processes, and translate functional needs into appropriate system configurations. Conduct system testing, investigate technical and functional issues, troubleshoot errors, and implement appropriate resolutions. Prepare functional specifications, configuration documentation, and support materials to ensure clear communication and maintain reliable project documentation. Work closely with technical teams to coordinate custom developments, system enhancements, and integrations with other HR platforms. Contribute to SAP HCM implementation, support, and upgrade projects, helping maintain system stability and continuously improve HR operations. Requirements: Demonstrate strong hands-on experience with SAP HCM, particularly Time Management (TM), Organizational Management (OM), and Personnel Administration (PA). Possess a solid understanding of Personnel Administration actions, employee master data management, and organizational structures within SAP HCM. Have practical experience configuring SAP HCM Time Management, including work schedules, absence and attendance management, and quota processing. Understand payroll-related processes and integrations involving SAP HCM PA and TM; familiarity with SAP Payroll integration is highly desirable. Bring experience supporting SAP HCM implementations, ongoing system operations, enhancements, or upgrade projects. Have the ability to analyze business requirements, translate them into functional solutions, and identify opportunities to improve HR processes. Demonstrate strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex system issues and deliver effective resolutions. Be comfortable preparing functional specifications, maintaining documentation, and collaborating with technical teams on custom developments and integrations. Possess excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with both business users and technical professionals. Demonstrate a proactive, detail-oriented, and collaborative approach, with a strong commitment to system quality, data accuracy, and continuous improvement. jobs.title: Container Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Platform reliability and operations: Define and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), and error budgets for the container platform. Develop policies that connect reliability targets to platform changes and deployment decisions. Operational readiness and observability: Lead Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) for new capabilities and significant changes. Establish meaningful uptime metrics and improve visibility through comprehensive metrics, logs, and distributed traces across platform components. Incident management and continuous improvement: Participate in the team's on-call rotation, respond to platform incidents, and drive issues through resolution and follow-up. Facilitate blameless postmortems, identify recurring failure patterns, and implement lasting improvements that reduce detection and recovery times. Platform software engineering: Build, maintain, and deploy production-grade automation, controllers, operators, internal tools, and platform APIs. Develop custom solutions when existing tools do not adequately address the underlying technical challenges. Deployment automation and release management: Design and improve platform CI/CD pipelines, rollout mechanisms, and release processes that enable safe, efficient, and predictable deployments. Security and operational automation: Implement security automation covering intrusion detection, automated remediation, and patch management. Identify repetitive operational tasks and eliminate toil through reliable automation. Testing and quality assurance: Develop and maintain automated testing suites and pipelines that validate platform releases before they reach production workloads. Architecture and ecosystem development: Evaluate and evolve the container technology stack, including orchestration, runtimes, networking, workload isolation, and observability tools. Conduct failure-mode analysis, map dependencies, and design resilient architectures for multi-tenant environments. Infrastructure efficiency: Improve platform architecture to optimize infrastructure costs while maintaining appropriate standards for security, reliability, and performance across tenants. Engineering enablement: Help product teams adopt sustainable operational practices, including effective alerting, escalation procedures, runbook coverage, and reduced notification noise. Requirements: Professional experience: At least five years of experience in platform engineering, Kubernetes or container platform operations, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or production infrastructure, including operating production systems at scale and participating in on-call rotations. Deep technical expertise: Strong expertise in at least one of the following areas, ideally with experience across two: Container tooling and ecosystem: In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes, containerd, OCI/CRI standards, and the broader Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) ecosystem. Familiarity with technologies such as Argo CD, Argo Rollouts, Cilium, eBPF, Gateway API, Karpenter, KEDA, gVisor, or Kata Containers is valuable. Software engineering: Ability to write production-quality code in Go or a comparable systems programming language, build controllers and operators, and design platform APIs and custom automation solutions. Operational excellence and SRE: Strong understanding of SLOs, error budgets, operational KPIs, incident response, blameless postmortems, and strategies for reducing mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to recover (MTTR). Multi-tenant infrastructure: Experience with large-scale, multi-tenant systems and an understanding of workload isolation mechanisms, including namespaces, role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, resource quotas, virtual clusters, and stronger isolation models such as VM-based runtimes. Cloud infrastructure: Confident working with AWS environments, including multiple accounts, IAM, and VPC networking. Infrastructure as code: Experie

jobs.title: Business Owners - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Test digital merchant tools: Independently evaluate new platform features, digital storefront solutions, and AI-powered recommendations designed to support local business management and customer engagement. Audit business profiles and search results: Review AI-generated business descriptions, local search results, and mapping integrations to verify their accuracy against actual business operations. Provide structured feedback: Document detailed, actionable observations about usability, relevance, and the practical value of digital tools for local businesses. Identify inaccuracies and anomalies: Detect and report cases where AI systems misrepresent business categories, services, opening hours, or local market characteristics. Evaluate user experience: Assess digital workflows from a merchant's perspective, highlighting usability issues, friction points, and opportunities for improvement. Contribute industry expertise: Apply firsthand knowledge of business operations to benchmark AI performance and help improve the accuracy and reliability of digital commerce systems. Deliver independent assessments: Complete evaluations autonomously and provide clear, evidence-based feedback in accordance with project guidelines and deliverable requirements. Requirements: Business ownership or management experience: Demonstrable professional experience as an active owner, operator, or primary manager of a business in the food and beverage, hospitality and lodging, local services, or retail sectors. Verified Google Business Profile: Current ownership or active management of a verified Google Business Profile associated with your business is mandatory. Operational business knowledge: A strong understanding of day-to-day business activities, customer engagement, local search visibility, and digital storefront management. Analytical and communication skills: Ability to identify technical inaccuracies, explain user experience issues, and provide clear, structured, and actionable feedback. Attention to detail: A meticulous approach to reviewing business information, digital workflows, search results, and consumer-facing representations. Independent working style: Ability to manage assignments autonomously, follow evaluation guidelines, and deliver consistent, high-quality results remotely. Digital proficiency: Comfort using online platforms, business listings, mapping tools, and digital commerce technologies. Local market expertise: Familiarity with the specific needs, practices, and nuances of your business sector and geographic market. Equipment and connectivity: Access to a secure computer and reliable, high-speed internet connection to complete project assignments. Benefits: Competitive hourly compensation: Earn between $25 and $100 USD per hour , depending on your experience, expertise, and geographic location. The final rate may vary from the advertised range. Flexible freelance engagement: Work as an independent contractor, with flexibility to manage assignments alongside your existing business responsibilities. Fully remote work: Complete project tasks remotely without the need to commute to a physical office. Real-world impact: Help improve AI accuracy, local search representation, and digital tools used by merchants and consumers. Leverage your expertise: Apply your practical business knowledge to emerging AI technologies without needing to transition into a traditional technology role. Independent working environment: Evaluate tools and provide feedback autonomously, using your firsthand experience as a business owner or operator. Contractor arrangement: This is a freelance engagement. Company-sponsored benefits, including health insurance and paid time off, are not provided. Contractors are responsible for supplying their own equipment and internet connection.

Manage the international subsidiary structure, including board meetings, corporate records, entity reorganizations, intercompany agreements, and local compliance requirements. Support board governance by preparing agendas and materials, documenting meetings, and maintaining accurate records of corporate decisions and actions. Oversee employee equity programs and structure, negotiate, and execute employee stock sale transactions. Lead the legal execution of fundraising, M&A, financing, and other strategic transactions, ensuring appropriate risk management and regulatory compliance. Manage the investment portfolio and oversee transaction execution for venture capital investments and related activities. Develop and implement efficient legal and business processes that enable international operations to scale sustainably. Advise cross-functional teams on software integrations, intellectual property, licensing, and open-source licensing considerations. Translate complex legal matters into clear, practical recommendations that support business objectives and enable informed decision-making. Strong expertise in securities law compliance, corporate governance, and legal matters affecting private or late-stage companies. Proven experience managing international subsidiaries and handling complex corporate transactions, including financing rounds, M&A, equity transactions, and strategic investments. Experience overseeing employee equity programs, stock plans, and related transactions; familiarity with tender offers, fund formations, public offerings, or comparable complex transactions is an advantage. Knowledge of intellectual property, software integrations, licensing, and open-source licensing, with an understanding of the legal considerations associated with global technology operations. International legal experience and familiarity with cross-border regulatory environments are highly desirable. Ability to manage multiple complex matters simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and operate independently in a fast-paced, globally distributed organization. Strong analytical, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly and concisely. A pragmatic, commercially minded approach to legal work, with a focus on finding efficient solutions and enabling business outcomes rather than relying solely on formal documentation. An adaptable, curious, and collaborative mindset, with the confidence to ask questions, learn from mistakes, and work constructively with diverse teams. Genuine enthusiasm for open-source principles and the open web, alongside a commitment to making technology accessible and useful to people worldwide. International collaboration: Work alongside colleagues across numerous countries and cultural backgrounds, contributing to a global technology environment. jobs.title: Litigation Paralegal

jobs.title: Staff Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Backend Software Engineer based in Romania. As a Staff Backend Software Engineer, you’ll help build and evolve a mission-critical transaction platform that enables secure cryptocurrency transfers between financial institutions, fintechs, and exchanges worldwide. You’ll tackle complex distributed systems challenges where data integrity, tenant isolation, reliability, and auditability are essential in a regulated environment. Working primarily with Go and PostgreSQL, you’ll shape core architectural decisions, improve platform scalability, and ensure predictable performance as transaction volumes grow. You’ll also help establish effective engineering practices for AI-assisted development, ensuring generated code meets rigorous production standards. In this remote-first, collaborative environment, you’ll partner with product, compliance, and customer-facing teams while mentoring engineers and taking ownership of the systems you deliver. Accountabilities: Design, develop, and maintain core components of a distributed transaction platform. Build resilient systems that preserve data correctness, tenant isolation, and auditability, including when failures occur. Improve scalability as transaction volumes and the number of institutions per node increase, maintaining predictable latency and database performance. Produce clear technical design documents and provide constructive, detailed reviews of architecture proposals and code. Integrate AI coding agents into daily development workflows and improve specifications, context, and review practices to ensure generated code is safe for production. Collaborate with product, compliance, and customer-facing teams to translate regulatory obligations and customer needs into reliable software. Take end-to-end ownership of production systems, including tracing, alerting, incident response, and post-incident follow-ups. Mentor other engineers, share technical expertise, and contribute to the team's engineering standards. Participate in the on-call rotation to support platform reliability and operational continuity. Requirements Typically 8+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of delivering complex technical projects end to end and helping other engineers grow. Strong distributed systems design expertise, including asynchronous processing, failure handling, and systems where correctness takes priority over feature delivery. Strong Go experience, or substantial production experience with another statically typed backend language such as Java, Kotlin, Rust, or C#, with the ability and motivation to start shipping Go code within the first few weeks. Deep PostgreSQL knowledge, including schema design, query planning, locking, transaction isolation levels, live database migrations, and multi-tenant data management. Practical cloud engineering experience with AWS or GCP, including IAM, networking, managed databases, queues, and storage. Ability to read and modify Terraform and troubleshoot production issues using traces and logs. Daily experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor, including writing specifications, providing context, decomposing tasks, critically reviewing generated code, and understanding where these tools can fail. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly and concisely in a remote environment that relies on documentation and asynchronous collaboration. Solid security fundamentals for handling sensitive data, including encryption in transit and at rest, key management, data minimization, and least-privilege access. Familiarity with any of the following is an advantage: applied cryptography, decentralized identity protocols such as DIDs, verifiable credentials and DIDComm, regulated finance, payments, compliance frameworks such as the Travel Rule, AML, ISO 20022

Deliver executive reporting: Develop dashboards, management reports, Board presentations, and monthly financial results that provide leadership with clear visibility into business performance. Analyze financial performance: Monitor monthly results, leading indicators, and key performance indicators (KPIs), identify variances, and provide actionable recommendations to support annual plan attainment. Drive commercial and strategic analysis: Evaluate growth opportunities, establish commercial targets, assess strategic initiatives, and support data-driven business decisions. Manage financial models and analytics: Maintain and improve financial models, analytical frameworks, reporting methodologies, and business intelligence tools to enhance the accuracy and usefulness of financial insights. Collaborate across departments: Partner with Product Managers to consolidate market insights and competitive intelligence, and work closely with Accounting and Investor Relations on month-end close, financial reviews, and reporting activities. Improve financial systems and processes: Lead cross-functional initiatives that strengthen financial controls, improve data quality, streamline workflows, and increase reporting efficiency. Support IPO readiness: Contribute to the preparation of critical public financial documents, investor materials, and regulatory filings associated with an initial public offering. Lead and develop the team: Guide a regional team of financial analysts, promote analytical excellence, and establish effective processes for delivering accurate, timely, and relevant financial information. Requirements Academic background: Strong academic performance, with a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline preferred. Technology sector experience: Experience working in a high-growth technology or software business with operations across multiple countries and currencies, ideally with a combination of go-to-market models. Analytical capabilities: Exceptional problem-solving skills, strong commercial awareness, and the ability to translate complex financial data into clear recommendations for business leaders. Financial tools proficiency: Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills, along with experience using business intelligence tools to develop dashboards, analyze trends, and support executive reporting. Accounting knowledge: A solid understanding of core accounting principles, financial reporting, month-end close processes, and variance analysis. Strategic communication: Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to present financial insights clearly and collaborate effectively with senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders. Leadership and ownership: A results-oriented mindset, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects while consistently meeting commitments. Integrity and professional judgment: High ethical standards, authenticity, credibility, and sound judgment when handling sensitive financial information. Adaptability and curiosity: A self-motivated approach, willingness to explore diverse business challenges, and enthusiasm for continuous learning and process improvement. Additional qualifications: An MBA, relevant professional certifications, or an equivalent combination of education and experience would be beneficial. jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a remote administrative and client support professional, you will help maintain efficient operations, deliver responsive communication, and ensure that student and client information is accurate and up to date. Your responsibilities will include: Administrative operations and student support: Review student diagnostic assessments and pre-class assignments to identify missing information, incomplete work, or areas requiring follow-up. Prepare and distribute individualized homework lists based on student progress and established procedures. Student progress tracking: Maintain accurate records across gradebooks, homework trackers, progress reports, Google Classroom, spreadsheets, and internal systems. Monitor recurring tasks and ensure information is organized and accessible. Student onboarding and course preparation: Organize student information, prepare learning materials, support access to required platforms, complete pre-course checks, release course materials, and prepare operational documentation. Mock exam assistance: Support practice examinations by proctoring sessions, reviewing submissions, and grading practice exams according to provided training and guidelines. Bilingual client communication: Communicate professionally in English and Spanish with students, parents, and prospective clients through phone calls, email, and messaging platforms. Student follow-up: Follow up on missing assignments, deadlines, corrections, and course expectations. Monitor communication channels during assigned shifts and document issues or relevant updates. Client intake and onboarding coordination: Assist with client intake, scheduling, onboarding activities, appointment coordination, and operational follow-ups to support a smooth client experience. Sales and CRM support: Assist with communications involving prospective clients, maintain organized client records, and update CRM systems to track interactions, onboarding progress, and follow-up activities. Technology and systems support: Use Google Workspace, Google Classroom, CRM platforms, and other business applications to manage daily responsibilities. Identify and communicate system-related issues proactively, following established procedures and using sound judgment when unexpected situations arise. Team collaboration and process improvement: Coordinate with team members to complete tasks accurately and on time. Participate in meetings, training sessions, and improvement initiatives while communicating progress, scheduling concerns, and operational challenges. Adaptability and continuous learning: Learn new software, procedures, and workflows as business needs evolve, taking on additional responsibilities within the agreed scope of services. Requirements: The ideal candidate is bilingual, detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable balancing administrative responsibilities with customer-facing communication. You should be able to work independently in a remote environment, follow established procedures, and adapt quickly to new tools and changing priorities. Excellent organizational, time-management, recordkeeping, and attention-to-detail skills.
