jobs.title: AI Support Operations Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Optimize AI Support Performance: Take ownership of the AI support agent's effectiveness, identifying opportunities to improve resolution rates, answer accuracy, customer satisfaction, and escalation decisions. Maintain Accurate Knowledge: Collaborate with internal policy and product experts to ensure the AI agent has access to current, reliable information and provides consistent, accurate responses. Analyze Performance and Identify Root Causes: Review successful resolutions, escalations, and unsuccessful interactions to identify recurring issues, investigate underlying causes, and prioritize improvements. Test and Measure Enhancements: Design and conduct tests before and after implementing changes, document results, and evaluate their impact on the AI agent's performance. Configure AI Behavior and Workflows: Develop and refine AI guidance, response tone, procedures, and workflows within Intercom Fin to ensure interactions are clear, empathetic, accurate, and aligned with established service standards. Improve Human Handoffs: Ensure customers can reach a human support specialist smoothly whenever their requests require additional expertise, judgment, or personalized assistance. Expand AI Capabilities: Identify opportunities to introduce AI support across additional products, services, and more complex customer journeys. Monitor Emerging AI Technologies: Stay informed about new Intercom features and developments in AI-powered customer support, run targeted experiments, and recommend practical innovations based on their demonstrated value. Coordinate Cross-Functional Improvements: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and internal knowledge owners to resolve issues, clarify data requirements, implement integrations, and improve the AI agent's capabilities. Communicate Results and Build Feedback Loops: Report performance insights and recommendations to Customer Care leadership, prioritize improvement requests, and establish a clear process for teams to flag issues and track their resolution. Requirements Hands-On Intercom Fin Experience: Demonstrated experience configuring and improving Intercom Fin, including its guidance, workflows, or procedures, with measurable results to show for your work. Excellent Communication and Writing Skills: The ability to produce clear, accurate, natural, and empathetic customer-facing responses, with strong judgment about when an answer is incomplete, misleading, or inappropriate. Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Experience identifying patterns in performance data, investigating root causes, developing solutions, and measuring whether changes deliver the intended results. Technical Confidence: Comfort with technical configurations and the ability to discuss integrations, workflows, and implementation requirements effectively with engineering teams. AI Knowledge and Curiosity: A strong interest in AI-powered support technologies, a willingness to experiment with new tools, and the ability to distinguish practical innovations from unproven hype. Project and Stakeholder Management: The ability to translate findings into clear recommendations, coordinate cross-functional teams, prioritize improvements, and follow through on implementation. Adaptability and Initiative: A proactive, independent mindset, intellectual curiosity, creativity, integrity, and a willingness to test new approaches and learn from setbacks. Customer-Centric Approach: A genuine commitment to improving customer experiences through reliable, accessible, and thoughtful support. Preferred Industry Experience: Familiarity with data privacy, insurance, healthcare, or other regulated service environments is an advantage. Mission Alignment: An interest in building accessible, globally relevant services that help people work and live across geographical borders. Benefits Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in the world within a globally distributed team. Global Health and Travel Coverage: Access t

jobs.title: HR & People Operations Expert
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Design Realistic HR Tasks: Develop multi-step assignments based on practical HR responsibilities, including payroll operations, workforce planning, policy interpretation, and employee lifecycle processes, using relevant reference documents and clear instructions. Establish Objective Evaluation Criteria: Create structured grading rubrics and measurable standards that enable qualified reviewers to assess submissions consistently and reach comparable conclusions. Assess Professional Judgment: Design tasks that require candidates to interpret information, analyze documentation, and apply HR expertise rather than simply retrieve facts or provide generic answers. Prepare Supporting Documentation: Create, organize, or source relevant materials, including HR policies, payroll reports, headcount data, employment agreements, and other operational reference files. Ensure Task Quality and Clarity: Identify and flag assignments that are ambiguous, incomplete, or difficult to evaluate reliably, ensuring that only well-defined and assessable tasks are submitted. Meet Project Deadlines: Deliver approved assignments according to established timelines, quality expectations, and project requirements. Requirements Relevant Professional Experience: At least five years of hands-on experience in payroll, workforce planning, HR policy implementation, or employee lifecycle operations, with direct responsibility for performing or managing the work rather than exclusively supervisory or adjacent exposure. HR Process and Standards Expertise: Experience developing, applying, or evaluating structured procedures, such as HR policies, payroll checklists, process documentation, compliance frameworks, or training assessments. Analytical and Evaluation Skills: Strong attention to detail and the ability to interpret complex information, apply consistent standards, and develop clear, objective assessment criteria. Document and Data Management: Confidence working across spreadsheets, operational reports, policy documents, employment agreements, and other HR reference materials simultaneously. Written and Verbal English: Strong English communication skills, with a minimum B2 proficiency level; C1 proficiency is preferred. Professional Qualifications: An HR certification such as SHRM, CIPD, PHR, or an equivalent credential is an advantage but is not mandatory. Independent Working Style: Strong organizational skills, sound professional judgment, reliability, and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work within agreed deadlines. Benefits Competitive Hourly Compensation: Earn between $45 and $90 per hour , depending on the engagement and applicable terms. Remote Work Flexibility: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with the opportunity to contribute your expertise without being tied to a specific office location. Independent Contract Arrangement: Work as a freelancer or independent contractor, with greater autonomy over how you organize and deliver your work. Long-Term Project Potential: A 12-month contract offering the opportunity to contribute to ongoing project work. Part-Time Commitment: Approximately 10 hours per week , making this opportunity suitable for professionals seeking a flexible project alongside other commitments. Meaningful Professional Contribution: Apply your practical HR knowledge to the development of structured, high-quality assessments grounded in real workplace scenarios. Prompt Project Start: The engagement is expected to begin as soon as possible.

Promote the Mission: Communicate the value of personal development initiatives, expand audience reach, and build meaningful connections with prospective participants and partners. Support Business Development: Contribute to building and strengthening an independent business through relationship-building, networking, and strategic planning. Drive Continuous Learning: Stay informed about personal development practices, leadership strategies, and innovative approaches to building sustainable business opportunities. Build Collaborative Relationships: Work with a network of growth-oriented professionals to exchange ideas, share experiences, and support collective progress. Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Strong relationship-building abilities, active listening, and confidence in engaging with diverse audiences. Self-Starter Attitude: A proactive, independent approach to work, with the discipline to manage priorities, set goals, and take initiative. jobs.title: Lead Security Engineer - Vulnerability Response (Imunify360)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own the vulnerability response pipeline: Design, build, and operate an end-to-end workflow covering vulnerability intake, triage, analysis, AI-assisted rule generation, testing, release, and public disclosure. Expand automated WAF protection: Extend the existing AI-assisted vulnerability response pipeline from WordPress plugin protection to ModSecurity and Coraza WAF rules. Develop and maintain security rules: Write, review, and refine ModSecurity/SecLang rules to detect and mitigate real-world web application vulnerabilities and attack patterns. Validate protection before release: Build automated test harnesses that evaluate rules against known exploits, representative traffic, and legitimate requests to minimize false positives and avoid disrupting customer websites. Integrate AI into security workflows: Use AI and large language model (LLM) tools to accelerate vulnerability analysis and rule generation, while implementing validation processes to ensure the accuracy and reliability of generated outputs. Lead and mentor security analysts: Manage priorities, review technical work, support professional development, and remove blockers to help the team deliver effective protection quickly. Measure and improve outcomes: Define, monitor, and continuously improve key performance indicators, including time-to-protection, critical vulnerability coverage, and false-positive rates. Automate security advisories: Integrate public advisory generation into the vulnerability response pipeline and collaborate with marketing to establish appropriate formats, review processes, and publication workflows. Analyze vulnerabilities and exploits: Interpret vulnerability disclosures, advisories, and source code changes to understand exploit mechanisms and translate findings into effective defensive rules. Balance speed and precision: Make informed decisions under time pressure while ensuring that new security controls protect customers without blocking legitimate traffic. Drive continuous improvement: Identify bottlenecks across the response process, improve automation and testing, and ensure the pipeline evolves with emerging threats and customer needs. Requirements At least 5 years of experience in web or application security , including vulnerability research, detection engineering, WAF engineering, or a closely related field. Deep understanding of common web application attack classes, including SQL injection (SQLi), cross-site scripting (XSS), remote code execution (RCE), authentication bypass, path traversal, file upload vulnerabilities, and insecure deserialization. Strong practical experience writing WAF rules using ModSecurity/SecLang, OWASP Core Rule Set (CRS), or comparable technologies. Proficiency with regular expressions and the ability to translate observed attack patterns into accurate, effective detection rules. Ability to read and analyze PHP source code and understand vulnerabilities through security advisories, patches, and code diffs. Strong Python programming skills, including experience building and maintaining production-grade automation pipelines. Experience with CI/CD workflows, automated testing, and integrating validation into software delivery processes. Regular hands-on use of AI and LLM tools, with sound judgment about their limitations and the ability to independently verify generated analysis and code. Demonstrated ability to lead a technical project end to end, from defining the objective and designing the solution through implementation, deployment, and performance measurement. A product-oriented mindset, with the ability to evaluate technical decisions in terms of customer impact, operational risk, and measurable outcomes. Strong ownership and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify process bottlenecks and address underlying causes rather than isolated symptoms. Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues, raise risks early, and collaborate effectivel

jobs.title: Data API Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Improve database connectivity: Work on the PostgreSQL driver used by PostgREST, built on Hasql, identifying bottlenecks and implementing optimizations to improve performance and efficiency. Develop Data API capabilities: Contribute to PostgREST development by implementing new features, resolving bugs, and advancing the platform toward a scalable, multitenant Data API. Enhance reliability and performance: Investigate service issues, diagnose root causes, and implement improvements that strengthen API stability, responsiveness, and overall performance. Strengthen observability: Improve monitoring and diagnostic capabilities to make it easier to identify, investigate, and resolve operational issues. Handle technical incidents: Resolve incidents and escalated support requests, ensuring technical problems are addressed effectively and recurring issues are reduced. Collaborate across engineering teams: Work with other teams to troubleshoot and resolve integration issues involving the broader platform and its services. Support developers and users: Help users overcome technical challenges by investigating reported problems and communicating solutions clearly to people with varying levels of technical expertise. Contribute to open source: Participate in the development and improvement of open-source software, collaborating with the community to strengthen shared tools and infrastructure. Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve code quality, system architecture, debugging workflows, and the overall developer experience. Requirements At least 3 years of professional experience with Haskell , with strong proficiency in the language and its practical application to software development. Experience using the C programming language and the ability to work with systems-level code when needed. Strong knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL , including experience writing and working with PL/pgSQL scripts. Experience debugging applications in Linux environments , with the ability to investigate complex technical problems and identify root causes. A strong track record of contributing to open-source projects; experience maintaining an open-source project is an advantage. Experience providing technical support to users with different levels of technical knowledge, including diagnosing issues and explaining solutions clearly. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate performance bottlenecks and improve the reliability of complex systems. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering teams and contribute to shared technical objectives. A proactive, ownership-oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently and manage tasks in an asynchronous environment. Enthusiasm for open-source development, developer tooling, and building reliable, high-performance APIs. Benefits Fully remote work: Work remotely from Poland, with a globally distributed team and no requirement to work from a central office. Coworking support: Access to a WeWork membership or coworking allowance to help create a productive work environment. Equity ownership: Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), giving team members the opportunity to share in the company's long-term growth. Technology allowance: Budget for essential work equipment, including a laptop, monitor, headphones, or other tools that support productivity. Health insurance: The employer covers 100% of employee health insurance costs and 80% of dependent coverage, subject to applicable plan terms and local availability. Flexible working arrangements: An asynchronous work culture that emphasizes trust, autonomy, and the ability to manage your own schedule. Professional development: Annual education allowance for courses, books, conferences, and other learning opportunities. Annual company off-sites: Opportunities to connect and collaborate in person with colleagues during a company-wide gathering. Open-source environment: The opp

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Storage
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Enhance storage capabilities: Improve analytics storage offerings and support open file formats, including Apache Iceberg and DuckLake, to enable efficient storage and management of analytical data. Optimize asset delivery: Develop asset optimization capabilities that improve delivery speed and performance for websites and mobile applications. Expand edge infrastructure: Build and improve the edge network to accelerate uploads and implement features such as automatic cache invalidation. Improve storage server performance: Enhance the performance, observability, scalability, and reliability of the storage server through continuous monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization. Develop storage exploration tools: Collaborate with frontend engineers to build a fast, intuitive, and powerful storage explorer. Improve developer experience: Enhance APIs, client libraries, and command-line interface (CLI) tools to deliver a seamless, consistent experience throughout the development workflow. Strengthen upload and download reliability: Identify opportunities to improve upload resilience, optimize protocol behavior, and streamline processing across different clients and environments. Contribute to open source: Develop and maintain open-source storage server components and contribute improvements to upstream dependencies where appropriate. Resolve technical issues: Address escalated support cases, investigate underlying causes, and implement systemic improvements that prevent recurring problems. Work across the technology stack: Contribute to backend development, infrastructure deployment, monitoring, scaling, and service operations as needed. Drive projects end to end: Take ownership of engineering initiatives, from identifying problems and designing solutions through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Requirements At least 5 years of backend engineering experience , including operating Node.js applications in production environments. Experience designing, building, or operating highly scalable distributed systems. Comfort working across the technology stack, including backend application development and infrastructure deployment, monitoring, and scaling. Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. Experience with performance tuning, production troubleshooting, and improving the reliability of distributed services. Strong practical experience with PostgreSQL in production, including database tuning and troubleshooting. A demonstrated ownership mindset, with the ability to drive projects independently from initial problem definition through delivery. A strong appreciation for developer experience and a commitment to building intuitive, reliable tools that help developers work efficiently. Ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, asynchronous, globally distributed team environment. Nice-to-have qualifications: Previous experience building or maintaining developer tools and platforms. Solid knowledge of cloud infrastructure providers such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure. Experience with containerization technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes. Direct experience designing and operating large-scale file upload and download pipelines. Strong practical knowledge of content delivery networks (CDNs), including integration, caching strategies, and performance optimization. Experience with image and video processing tools such as Sharp, DSSIM, or FFmpeg. Familiarity with media formats and codecs such as AVIF, WebM, and Brotli. Experience with frontend technologies and frameworks such as React and Next.js. Interest in open-source software and contributing improvements to shared libraries, infrastructure, and developer communities. Benefits Fully remote work: Work remotely from Slovenia, with a globally distributed team and no requirement to work from a central office. Coworking support: Access to a WeWork membership

jobs.title: Head of Content and Editorial
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will own the editorial vision, content quality, and performance of content initiatives, combining strategic direction with hands-on editing and continuous experimentation. Your main responsibilities will include: Content Strategy and Editorial Direction: Define what content should be created, who it should serve, and how it supports business objectives, customer needs, and product positioning. Editorial Quality and Standards: Establish and maintain high editorial standards, reviewing and refining content to ensure clarity, accuracy, consistency, engagement, and practical value for readers. Hands-On Editing and Copywriting: Improve drafts through thoughtful editing, restructuring, and rewriting, identifying opportunities to strengthen messaging, storytelling, readability, and overall impact. AI-Assisted Content Creation: Develop and optimize AI-supported content workflows that improve productivity while ensuring outputs meet rigorous editorial standards and provide genuine value to readers. Writer Management and Development: Lead a small team of skilled writers, providing editorial guidance, constructive feedback, and clear expectations to strengthen individual capabilities and overall content quality. Content Performance and Analytics: Monitor content results, interpret performance metrics, identify successful approaches, and use data to guide editorial decisions and improve outcomes. Experimentation and Continuous Improvement: Test new content formats, topics, messaging, and production methods, learn from unsuccessful experiments, and scale approaches that demonstrate positive results. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with marketing, product teams, and executive leadership to understand the products, audience, and business priorities, ensuring content remains relevant and aligned with organizational goals. Editorial Ownership and Decision-Making: Work independently, identify opportunities proactively, make informed decisions, and take responsibility for both content quality and performance. Content Excellence: Build a culture focused on exceptional writing, strong editorial judgment, continuous learning, and meaningful business impact rather than simply maximizing content volume. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced editorial leader with excellent writing instincts, a proven ability to develop talented writers, and the strategic judgment to turn high-quality content into measurable business results. You should be comfortable combining hands-on editorial work with team leadership, AI-assisted production, and data-driven decision-making. Key qualifications include: Editorial Leadership: Demonstrated experience managing small teams of skilled writers and maintaining consistently high standards of content quality. Exceptional Editing and Copywriting: Outstanding writing, editing, and copywriting skills, with the ability to recognize strong content, identify weaknesses, and transform drafts into polished, compelling material. AI Content Expertise: Practical experience using AI tools to create, edit, and improve content efficiently while maintaining accuracy, originality, clarity, and editorial quality. Performance and Analytical Skills: Comfort working with content metrics, evaluating results, identifying patterns, and using performance data to inform strategic and editorial decisions. Strong Editorial Judgment: Well-developed editorial intuition built through substantial experience, with the confidence to make decisions, test new ideas, and evaluate their effectiveness. Technology and SaaS Experience: Background in technology, software, SaaS, or technical content, with the ability to understand complex products and communicate their value clearly. Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect editorial priorities with customer needs, product positioning, marketing objectives, and broader business goals. Independent Execution: A proactive, hands-on working style, with the ability to take owner

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer - Malware Detection
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will lead the development, evaluation, and deployment of machine learning systems that improve malware detection at scale while balancing accuracy, operational costs, and resource constraints. Your key responsibilities will include: Machine Learning Model Development: Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML models using production malware data to improve detection coverage and identify threats that traditional signatures and rules may miss. Malware Classification and Triage: Develop models that distinguish malicious files from benign content, prioritize suspicious files for deeper inspection, and route samples to the most appropriate detection engines. Automated Signature Generation: Build systems that generate detection signatures from emerging malware campaigns, helping security analysts respond faster to new and evolving threats. Context-Aware Threat Detection: Develop methods to identify malicious content that requires contextual analysis, including phishing pages, webshells, script injections, and compromised website components. Detection and Cleanup Optimization: Improve detection precision and cleanup effectiveness so that infected websites remain clean after remediation and recurring threats can be identified. Model Evaluation and Validation: Establish rigorous evaluation frameworks using time-based and campaign-based dataset splits, historical false-positive and false-negative cases, and regression testing to prevent data leakage and verify improvements before deployment. Inference and Resource Optimization: Optimize model throughput, latency, CPU usage, memory consumption, and cost per file to support reliable deployment across large hosting fleets. Production Deployment and Monitoring: Move models from experimentation into production, using shadow deployments and controlled releases to gather evidence before enabling live detection. Continuous Learning and Retraining: Incorporate fresh analyst feedback and newly identified false negatives into training datasets, establish regular retraining cycles, and monitor trends in detection rates and model performance. ML Infrastructure and Experimentation: Develop reusable training pipelines, maintain dataset tooling, make effective use of GPU resources, and enable multiple parallel research and development efforts. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with malware analysts, detection engineers, and infrastructure teams to investigate customer-reported detection failures, understand emerging threats, and translate operational findings into model improvements. Technical Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Document architectural decisions, evaluation methods, model limitations, hardware requirements, and production results. Participate in asynchronous collaboration and blameless post-mortems to continuously improve engineering practices. Delivery Against Milestones: Train and evaluate an initial production-data model during the first month, bring multiple models into production or shadow testing by month three, and help establish ML as a major source of new detections within the first year. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines substantial production ML experience with hands-on transformer expertise, strong evaluation discipline, and the ability to engineer efficient models for adversarial security environments. You should be comfortable making evidence-based decisions, communicating asynchronously, and taking ownership of the full ML lifecycle. Key qualifications include: Production ML Experience: At least five years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production, including at least two years in an adversarial domain such as cybersecurity, fraud, spam, or abuse prevention. Transformer Model Expertise: Practical experience training and fine-tuning transformer models, including data preparation, code tokenization, LoRA/QLoRA or full fine-tuning, distillation, and quantization. Experience should extend beyond calli

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer - Email Security
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will contribute across the machine learning lifecycle and production engineering stack, ensuring that email detection models are accurate, efficient, and reliable in real-world hosting environments. Your responsibilities will include: Model Training and Deployment: Train, evaluate, and release spam-detection models, including building and maintaining training corpora, selecting decision thresholds, analyzing precision and recall, and determining whether models are ready for production. Production ML Engineering: Develop the production components of a new email-filtering engine in Go, including the inference service, mail-filter integrations, tokenization, and streaming message parsing. Detection Quality Improvement: Investigate customer-reported spam and phishing incidents, trace detection failures, and implement appropriate fixes through rules, dataset improvements, or model retraining. Model Performance Optimization: Balance detection rates against false-positive risks, ensuring legitimate messages are not unnecessarily blocked while malicious content is effectively identified. Training Infrastructure and Data Tooling: Maintain the corpus management tools and training infrastructure required to support reliable experimentation and model releases. Code and Model Reviews: Review and approve classifier, rule, and model changes to improve quality, share technical knowledge, and ensure releases can proceed without depending on a single engineer. Technical Collaboration: Help partner engineers understand classification outcomes, explain model scoring behavior, and provide clear technical guidance when questions arise. Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Write technical specifications, handbooks, merge-request descriptions, and post-mortems that make decisions understandable and support effective collaboration. Independent Delivery: Progress toward defined milestones, including independently shipping a rule-model release during the first month, delivering a component of the new engine to staging by month three, and supporting a model release independently by month six. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced machine learning engineer with a strong background in production classification systems, practical transformer expertise, and the engineering skills to deliver reliable security technology. You should be comfortable owning technical decisions, investigating complex detection issues, and communicating your work clearly. Key qualifications include: Production Detection Experience: At least five years of experience delivering detection or classification systems where false positives have meaningful consequences, such as anti-spam, anti-phishing, anti-malware, fraud prevention, or abuse detection. End-to-End ML Ownership: Experience independently taking at least one machine learning classifier into production, including corpus construction, threshold selection, error analysis, and release decisions. Transformer Training Expertise: Hands-on experience training transformers with PyTorch, including tokenizers, masked-language pre-training, fine-tuning, ONNX export, and CPU inference performance measurement. Systems and Development Skills: Strong practical knowledge of Linux, shell scripting, and Python, including working with shared servers and GPU resources. AI-Assisted Development: Regular use of AI coding agents and development tools to support engineering productivity. Written Communication: English proficiency at B2 level or higher, with particularly strong written communication skills for technical documentation, specifications, and code reviews. Ownership and Judgment: The ability to analyze model performance, make evidence-based release decisions, investigate difficult problems, and balance detection effectiveness with the cost of false positives. Additional experience that would be valuable includes: Email Protocols and Infrastructure: Knowledge of SMTP, MIME, transfer encodings, SPF, DKIM,

jobs.title: Head of Influencer Marketing
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Influencer Marketing Strategy: Lead the development and implementation of influencer marketing strategies for major consumer brands across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH). Creator Management: Oversee creator-related processes, ensuring effective collaboration with influencers and content creators throughout campaign planning and execution. Creative Concepts and Scriptwriting: Develop engaging creative concepts, campaign briefs, and scripts that align with brand objectives, resonate with target audiences, and encourage meaningful engagement. Campaign Development: Translate marketing objectives into compelling creator-led campaigns, ensuring creative consistency and alignment with each brand's positioning and goals. Founder Collaboration: Work closely with company founders to define priorities, refine creative strategies, and contribute to the overall growth of the business and its clients. Performance Analysis: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), evaluate campaign results, and identify opportunities to improve content effectiveness and marketing outcomes. Creative Optimisation: Analyse content assets and identify successful creative formats, messaging approaches, and creator partnerships to strengthen campaign performance. Trend and Talent Discovery: Stay informed about emerging social media trends, creator opportunities, audience preferences, and high-performing content formats to maintain a competitive edge. Continuous Improvement: Apply insights from campaign performance and advanced creative training to refine processes, improve creative output, and support scalable influencer marketing operations. Requirements Relevant Experience: Proven experience in creative strategy, ideally within a marketing agency or brand environment, with a strong understanding of influencer marketing and creator-led campaigns. Influencer and Social Media Expertise: A solid understanding of social media platforms, creator ecosystems, audience engagement, and the factors that contribute to successful influencer campaigns. Creative Thinking: The ability to develop original concepts, write compelling scripts, and translate marketing objectives into engaging content ideas that resonate with target audiences. Trend Awareness: A strong instinct for identifying emerging social media trends, recognising high-performing content, and understanding what makes creators and campaigns successful. Analytical Skills: The ability to interpret campaign KPIs, evaluate creative performance, and use data-driven insights to optimise content and marketing strategies. Communication Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a genuine ability to understand people, build relationships, and collaborate effectively with creators and internal stakeholders. Strategic Mindset: The ability to connect creative execution with broader business objectives, prioritise effectively, and make informed decisions in a dynamic environment. Ownership and Initiative: A proactive, ambitious, and results-oriented approach, with the willingness to take responsibility, solve problems independently, and go the extra mile to achieve outstanding results. Commitment and Availability: The ability to dedicate the necessary time and energy to a demanding, growth-oriented role while maintaining high standards of execution. Remote Working Skills: Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively in a fully remote environment. Benefits Competitive Salary: Earn between €5,000 and €10,000 per month, depending on experience and suitability for the role. Permanent Employment: Secure a long-term employment opportunity with the potential to grow alongside an expanding business. Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in the world. Flexible Working Hours: Enjoy flexibility in organising your schedule while remaining focused on campaign delivery and business outcomes. Professional Developme

jobs.title: IT Operations & Cybersecurity Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: IT Administration: Provision and manage user accounts, groups, permissions, and licences across Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, ensuring secure and efficient access to business applications. Endpoint Management: Prepare and onboard Windows and macOS laptops into mobile device management (MDM) platforms, coordinate remote device handovers, and maintain appropriate device configurations. Technical Support: Handle first-line support requests, including password resets, access issues, and routine troubleshooting, while escalating more complex incidents when necessary. IT Maintenance and Monitoring: Conduct weekly maintenance checks covering software patch status, backup logs, security alerts, and general system health to help maintain reliable operations. Documentation and Process Improvement: Document technical fixes, standard operating procedures, and runbooks to improve consistency, knowledge sharing, and operational efficiency. Cybersecurity Projects: Dedicate approximately 20% of your time to security-focused initiatives, including CVE research and briefings, laptop hardening scripts, incident-response playbooks, and ISO 27001 checklist development. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline IT workflows, strengthen security practices, and improve service delivery across a distributed client environment. Requirements Professional Experience: At least two years of hands-on experience in IT operations, helpdesk support, systems administration, or a comparable technical role. Cloud Administration: Practical experience administering Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, including user and group management, security policies, permissions, and basic troubleshooting. Endpoint Management: Familiarity with MDM solutions such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or equivalent platforms, including device enrolment and configuration. Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python, with the ability to automate routine tasks and improve operational workflows. Communication Skills: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to document technical processes clearly and collaborate effectively with distributed teams. German language skills are an advantage. Remote Working Readiness: A reliable internet connection, a professional remote working environment, and the ability to work independently across different time zones. Personal Attributes: A proactive, organised, and detail-oriented approach, with strong troubleshooting skills, sound judgement, and a willingness to learn and take ownership of responsibilities. Preferred Qualifications: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator, or Google Workspace Administrator certifications are advantageous. Security Knowledge: Exposure to cybersecurity and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar standards is a plus. Benefits Competitive Compensation: Hourly compensation within the advertised range of €10–€18, with the original role description specifying a typical rate of €12–€16 per hour, paid in euros. Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere. jobs.title: B2B Sales - Cold Caller / SDR mit Aufstiegschance zum High Ticket Closer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Pipeline Generation and Outbound Sales Convert warm inbound responses into qualified opportunities for the growth consulting offering. Proactively identify and contact potential customers through phone calls, email campaigns, and LinkedIn outreach. Work with the existing CRM to identify prospects, activate contacts, and generate new sales conversations. Book discovery calls and maintain consistent pipeline generation activity. Sales Development and Learning Shadow senior sales leaders during sales meetings to learn effective prospecting, qualification, and closing techniques. Participate actively in advanced sales training and apply coaching and feedback to improve performance. Build a strong understanding of the B2B sales process, high-ticket offers, and the needs of target customers. Track results, refine outreach approaches, and adjust quickly based on feedback and performance. Career Progression Demonstrate consistent performance and readiness for increased sales responsibility. Progress toward a Discovery Representative role, with the opportunity to become a Full-Cycle Closer based on results. Build the skills required for long-term growth in high-ticket sales and potentially consulting. Requirements Native-level German proficiency is essential for communicating effectively with prospects in the DACH market. Previous B2B sales experience is helpful but not required; motivation, coachability, and a strong work ethic are the primary priorities. A competitive, ambitious mindset and a genuine desire to achieve measurable results. Confidence in handling rejection and persistence when prospecting and following up with potential customers. Strong learning agility, with the ability to take feedback and apply it immediately. A proactive, action-oriented approach, including the ability to make decisions, test strategies, and adapt without waiting for perfect clarity. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage prospects professionally across phone, email, and LinkedIn. Discipline, resilience, and consistent personal habits; an athletic background or strong commitment to physical fitness is valued. Comfort working in a performance-based environment where earning potential is closely linked to results. A willingness to learn high-ticket sales techniques directly from experienced practitioners and invest sustained effort in professional development. Benefits On-target earnings: €60,000, with uncapped commission and the potential for high performers to earn more than €100,000 annually. Flexible work arrangement: Remote-first work environment with the freedom to work from anywhere, provided performance expectations are met. Career advancement: A defined progression path from Pipeline Representative to Discovery Representative, Full-Cycle Closer, and potentially consulting. Direct sales coaching: One-to-one coaching and opportunities to shadow experienced sales leaders during live sales activities. Advanced sales training: Access to a structured training program built on approximately 15 years of experience and more than 400 client cases. Executive coaching: Personalized development support from an executive coach with a former VP-level background at Nike, valued at more than €5,000 and provided at the company’s expense after onboarding. Established sales infrastructure: Access to a proprietary sales platform that generates warm leads daily and a CRM containing more than 50,000 active DACH-market contacts. Attractive B2B sales proposition: Work with an offer featuring an average deal size of approximately €20,000, a typical sales cycle of two to three weeks, and a reported closing rate of 30–40%. Performance-focused team: Collaborate with a small, ambitious team that values accountability, discipline, learning, and high performance. Contract flexibility: The role begins on a freelance basis, with the possibility—and stated intention in suitable cases—of transitioning to permanent employment

jobs.description: About Welo Global Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com Job Overview We are looking for a Financial Accountant to join our multinational, multi-currency European Finance team. The ideal candidate must be a self-starter, organised and flexible. We are looking for someone that has excellent interpersonal skills and ability to prioritise with a strong focus on quality, team work and adherence to global deadlines. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills are essential. Main Responsibilities: Strong Financial Accounting knowledge with robust experience in preparing monthly financial statements as this position will own the entire financial reporting cycle for multiple European legal entities Revenue and regulatory filings, both US Gaap and local statutory Management of outsource payroll providers, local payroll and employer taxes reporting monthly Global Transfer Pricing, working with external providers to produce annual TP documentation per country within the organisation Provision of data for multi-currency weekly, monthly and forecast working capital requirements Preparation and analysis of Trial Balance and Financial Statements Detailed review of Trial Balance Monthly reporting requirements Knowledge of IFRS / FRS102 Budget to Actual analysis Assistance in the preparation of audit and corporation taxations requirements and liaison with team leads Ad hoc projects with the wider Accounting team Requirements: Proficiency in Workday would be an advantage (or similar ERP software), proficient MS Excel skills (use of pivot tables, excellent knowledge of formulas) is essential. Knowledge, understanding and application of EU VAT regulation and reporting Accounting qualification – newly qualified or experienced with 2-3 years of working in similar environment Ability to work in an international remote team Qualified Accountant Proven track of experience in Accounts roles/functions Transfer pricing knowledge Committed, flexible and enthusiastic, team player Ability to take initiative

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.description: Accountabilities: New Business Development Follow up with qualified company registrations and inbound leads to understand customer needs and identify opportunities for broader adoption. Convert individual users into team, departmental, and enterprise-level customers. Develop relationships with prospective customers and identify opportunities to expand the customer base across relevant market segments. Account Growth and Expansion Manage and develop existing customer accounts, increasing adoption across additional teams and product modules. Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities for CRM, WhatsApp, AI-powered notes, e-signatures, invoicing, and other platform capabilities. Build long-term customer relationships by understanding evolving business needs and demonstrating relevant product value. Full-Cycle Sales and Deal Closing Own the sales process from discovery and product demonstrations through proposals, negotiations, security and legal reviews, and contract signature. Manage booked sales meetings and maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle. Work directly with the founders on strategic opportunities and high-value deals. Consistently monitor sales performance and work toward agreed revenue and activity targets. Sales Process Development Build the foundational sales infrastructure, including pipeline management, CRM standards, forecasting, sales playbooks, and effective handover processes. Document successful approaches and turn individual wins into repeatable sales practices. Track performance data, identify process improvements, and establish a more predictable approach to revenue growth. Strategic and Cross-Functional Collaboration Share customer feedback and market insights to influence pricing, packaging, product development, and go-to-market strategy. Work closely with the founders to prioritize opportunities and refine the commercial approach. Help establish a scalable sales motion that can support future team expansion and entry into additional markets. Requirements Approximately 4–8 years of B2B software sales experience, including at least 2 years with direct responsibility for closing deals. Native-level German proficiency or German at C2 level, together with good English communication skills. Demonstrated experience independently managing the full sales cycle, including discovery, product demonstrations, proposals, security and legal discussions, negotiations, and closing. Proven ability to expand existing customer accounts, in addition to acquiring new customers. Strong understanding of sales performance metrics, with the ability to clearly communicate targets, attainment, average contract value, and average sales cycle length from previous roles. Experience maintaining accurate CRM records, managing pipeline activity, forecasting, and building structured sales processes. Strong commercial judgment, customer discovery skills, and the ability to identify opportunities for broader product adoption. An independent, accountable, and execution-focused working style, with the confidence to communicate early when assumptions or strategies are not working. Comfort operating in a fast-growing environment where processes are still being developed and priorities may evolve quickly. Preferred experience: Working in a bootstrapped, profitable, or rapidly scaling software company with fewer than 200 employees. Preferred experience: Managing longer sales cycles involving German mid-market and enterprise customers. Preferred experience: Building repeatable sales processes from product-led growth or inbound demand. A specific degree, corporate background, prior knowledge of the product, or residence in Cologne is not required. Practical sales performance, customer understanding, transparency, and reliable execution are the priorities. Benefits Competitive compensation: €45,000–€55,000 annual base salary plus €65,000–€75,000 in target variable compensation, for total on-target earnings of €110,000–€130,000 at 100%

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer (Mid-level)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Improve CI/CD pipelines: Analyze existing deployment pipelines, determine the requirements of new tasks, and adapt established workflows to support reliable, repeatable software delivery. Develop infrastructure-as-code: Extend and maintain infrastructure modules in line with existing repository patterns, ensuring consistency, reliability, and maintainability across services. Apply data governance standards: Implement naming conventions, access controls, retention policies, and other governance requirements for new data services and infrastructure. Build self-service platform tooling: Develop and maintain a reusable template repository with preconfigured CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and governance standards so engineering teams can launch new pipelines with minimal manual intervention. Create reusable modules: Build tools and modules that simplify pipeline creation and reduce repetitive engineering work, making common platform tasks accessible through standardized workflows. Improve technical documentation: Write practical documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides that help engineers understand and operate systems independently without relying on individual team members. Own data access workflows: Design and manage access-request processes for data resources, reducing bottlenecks and enabling teams to obtain the permissions they need efficiently. Take ownership of platform tooling: Progress toward full responsibility for the template repository and infrastructure modules, including technical direction, prioritization, maintenance, and roadmap decisions. Collaborate across engineering disciplines: Work with data engineers, backend engineers, and infrastructure specialists to improve platform reliability and make shared tools useful across teams. Use AI tools responsibly: Incorporate AI-assisted development tools into everyday workflows while validating generated code, identifying potential errors, and explaining the reasoning behind technical decisions. Requirements Deployment ownership: Demonstrated experience independently owning a deployment path end to end, including building a pipeline, troubleshooting failures, resolving production issues, and documenting the solution in a runbook. Professional experience: Approximately two years or more of professional experience in software, data, platform, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering. Technical education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Python and SQL: Practical working knowledge of both languages and the ability to use them regularly in professional engineering tasks. CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code: Experience working with deployment pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices, with the ability to understand, adapt, and improve existing implementations. Code analysis and troubleshooting: Ability to navigate an unfamiliar codebase, explain how it works, identify potential failure points, and make sound technical judgments. Containers and cloud: Experience with Docker and familiarity with cloud computing concepts, particularly AWS. Previous experience with specific services such as SageMaker is not required. Cross-functional technical skills: Willingness and ability to work across data engineering, backend systems, and infrastructure rather than focusing exclusively on one area. AI-assisted development: Comfortable using AI coding assistants such as Copilot, Claude, or Cursor. You must be able to review generated code critically, explain why it is correct, and recognize when it is inaccurate or unsafe. Ownership and accountability: A proactive mindset, willingness to take responsibility for systems you modify, and honesty about failures, root causes, and lessons learned. Respect for established patterns: Ability to understand existing architecture and engineering conventions before deciding what should change. Communication and reasoning: Comfortable explaining technical decisions, defending implementation choice

jobs.title: Creative Strategist
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a Creative Strategist, you will lead the development and execution of creative concepts that help established consumer brands strengthen their digital presence and achieve their marketing objectives. Your responsibilities will include: Managing the end-to-end creative process for leading brands across the DACH market. Developing innovative creative concepts and content strategies tailored to brand objectives and target audiences. Writing scripts for organic social media content, advertisements, and marketing campaigns. Collaborating closely with the founders to align creative initiatives with broader business and marketing strategies. Analyzing campaign KPIs and content performance to identify opportunities for improvement. Continuously testing and optimizing creative assets, messaging, and formats to maximize audience engagement and campaign effectiveness. Monitoring social media trends, emerging formats, and high-performing content to inform creative decisions. Contributing to the development of creative best practices and helping brands maintain a competitive edge across digital platforms. Requirements: We are looking for a creative, analytical, and proactive professional with a strong understanding of digital content and the ability to turn audience insights into effective creative concepts. The ideal candidate will bring: Demonstrable experience in creative strategy, ideally within a marketing agency or brand environment. A strong understanding of social media platforms, content formats, and emerging digital trends. The ability to identify high-performing content and translate successful approaches into compelling creative concepts. Experience developing scripts and concepts for organic social content, advertisements, and marketing campaigns. Strong creative thinking, storytelling, and copywriting skills. The ability to analyze performance metrics and use insights to improve creative effectiveness. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a strong understanding of audience behavior and motivations. A proactive, results-oriented mindset and the ability to take ownership of projects from concept through execution. Full-time availability and a willingness to go the extra mile to deliver high-quality work. Benefits: Competitive salary: €4,000–€6,000 per month. Permanent employment contract offering long-term professional stability. Fully remote work: The flexibility to work from anywhere in the world. Career development opportunities: Build a strong technical foundation for progression into senior support, DevOps, or engineering-adjacent roles. Meaningful problem-solving: Move beyond basic support tasks to investigate root causes, improve performance, and contribute to system reliability. jobs.title: Senior Crude Oil Analyst
jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. About the Role As a Senior Crude Oil Research Analyst based in Dubai, you will serve as Kpler’s regional market authority on Middle Eastern physical crude dynamics, focusing on refinery activity, product yields, and downstream trade flows. Operating at the crossroads of physical cargo tracking and fundamental market analysis, you will translate complex refinery runs and crude movements into clear, actionable intelligence. In this high-impact individual contributor role, your insights will directly empower global commodity traders and market participants to navigate physical trading, arbitrage, and downstream market shifts with confidence. Key Responsibilities:: Deliver in-depth market intelligence: Conduct rigorous research on Middle Eastern physical crude and refined product markets, focusing on refinery runs, crude throughput, planned maintenance, and physical trade flows . Advance supply, demand, and refinery modeling: Maintain and refine proprietary supply-demand and refinery activity models, ensuring high data integrity compared against international benchmarks such as JODI, EIA, and IEA . Strengthen OSP advisory capabilities: Spearhead analysis and client-facing insights around Middle Eastern Official Selling Prices (OSPs), pricing mechanisms, and crude grade differentials . Publish timely market commentary: Author high-quality research reports, concise market briefs, and ad-hoc commentary highlighting Kpler’s proprietary cargo and inventory data for global clients . Represent Kpler across the industry: Present regional market insights during client briefings, industry webinars, and specialist media engagements to expand Kpler’s thought leadership across the Middle East . Drive commercial and product innovation: Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product Engineering teams to support pre-sales discussions, demonstrate data value, and co-develop next-generation analytics offerings . Experience & Background:: 5+ years of prior professional experience analysing crude oil markets, with deep familiarity with refinery operations, trading dynamics, and physical trade flows . Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical discipline (Economics, Finance, Engineering, Statistics, or Energy Management) . Proven track record of independently researching, analysing, and writing clear, data-driven market commentary and insights . Strong data analytics and quantitative skills, with demonstrated experience manipulating complex datasets to assess supply, demand, and refinery margins . Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to convey technical market context to clients, media, and cross-functional teams . Nice-to-haves: Practical experience using Kpler cargo-tracking data, AIS platforms, or similar energy intelligence tools . Working familiarity with data querying and analytical tools such as SQL, Python, or R . Direct familiarity with Middle Eastern crude pricing benchmarks, national oil company (NOC) pricing structures, and regional refinery configurations .

jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer (Swift)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Native iOS development: Develop, maintain, and enhance native iOS applications using Swift, delivering new features and improving existing functionality. UI development: Build and optimize user interfaces using SwiftUI and/or UIKit, ensuring consistency, responsiveness, and a high-quality user experience. Application performance and stability: Maintain robust application architecture, optimize performance, identify technical issues, and uphold high standards of code quality and reliability. Accessibility implementation: Design, implement, and refine accessibility features across native iOS applications to support users with diverse needs and abilities. VoiceOver integration: Ensure seamless compatibility with VoiceOver by optimizing screen-reader behavior, navigation, and the interpretation of interface elements. iOS accessibility APIs: Apply iOS Accessibility APIs and SwiftUI Accessibility capabilities to improve accessibility throughout the application. Dynamic Type and scalable interfaces: Implement Dynamic Type and scalable font sizes to ensure content remains readable and usable across different text-size preferences. Accessibility attributes: Configure and optimize accessibility labels, traits, values, and actions so that assistive technologies can accurately interpret and interact with interface components. Accessibility focus management: Implement and refine accessibility focus behavior to support intuitive navigation and predictable interactions for users relying on assistive technologies. Accessibility testing and quality assurance: Conduct hands-on accessibility testing, particularly with VoiceOver, to identify, investigate, and resolve accessibility-related defects. Standards compliance: Validate accessibility implementations against relevant guidelines, including WCAG 2.1 and WCAG 2.2, and contribute to continuous improvements in inclusive design. Cross-functional collaboration: Work with relevant technical stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, share expertise, and deliver accessible, maintainable, and user-centered mobile solutions. Requirements At least 5 years of professional experience in native iOS application development. Strong practical expertise in Swift and a solid understanding of native iOS development principles. Commercial experience developing and maintaining applications using SwiftUI and/or UIKit. Extensive hands-on experience implementing accessibility features in native iOS applications. Strong practical knowledge of VoiceOver, including testing and optimizing screen-reader navigation and interactions. Experience working with iOS Accessibility APIs and SwiftUI Accessibility features. Demonstrated experience implementing Dynamic Type and scalable font sizes to accommodate different accessibility preferences. Practical experience configuring and optimizing accessibility labels, traits, values, and actions. Experience implementing and troubleshooting accessibility focus management in native iOS interfaces. Proven ability to conduct accessibility testing, identify usability barriers, and implement effective technical solutions. Knowledge of accessibility standards and guidelines, ideally including WCAG 2.1 and WCAG 2.2. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality software. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with distributed, international teams. Good English communication skills, both written and verbal. A proactive, quality-focused mindset and the ability to work independently in a remote development environment. Benefits Fully remote work: Work remotely with the flexibility to manage your work from your preferred location anywhere. Competitive compensation: Receive a solid, competitive salary aligned with your skills and experience. International projects: Collaborate in a multinational environment and contribute to projects with an international scope. Com

jobs.title: App Security Expert
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Design and implement purpose-built application fixtures containing representative security vulnerabilities or secure implementations, with a focus on OWASP risks affecting large language model applications. Develop realistic test scenarios addressing critical LLM security concerns, including sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, and related application security weaknesses. Create deterministic test cases and comprehensive security-context manifests to evaluate application security posture consistently and reliably. Develop detailed reference solutions and hidden answer keys that enable accurate evaluation of vulnerable versus secure code by AI systems and security scanners. Assess and refine testing pipelines, ensuring synthetic security tasks are realistic, technically challenging, reproducible, and suitable for application security evaluation. Build, inspect, and secure application codebases, identifying advanced vulnerabilities and implementing appropriate remediation strategies. Contribute to the design and evaluation of security architectures for traditional applications and agent-based systems. Apply knowledge of AI-powered static application security testing (AI-SAST) and LLM security to improve automated vulnerability detection and assessment methodologies. Document technical findings, testing approaches, security insights, and remediation recommendations in clear, precise, and actionable formats. Collaborate with distributed teams through effective written and verbal communication, providing constructive feedback and reviewing peers' technical contributions. Support the continuous improvement of security evaluation pipelines by identifying weaknesses, proposing enhancements, and validating new testing approaches. Requirements Extensive experience in application security, secure software development, cybersecurity engineering, or a related field, ideally with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience. Strong understanding of application security principles, secure coding practices, vulnerability assessment, and remediation techniques. Familiarity with OSWE-level application security concepts, advanced vulnerability research, and practical security testing methodologies. Solid knowledge of large language model security, including common LLM vulnerabilities, prompt-related attack vectors, sensitive information disclosure, and excessive agency. Experience with AI-powered static application security testing (AI-SAST), automated code analysis, or AI-assisted security evaluation. Proven ability to design, implement, secure, and test application codebases, including identifying complex vulnerabilities and validating secure implementations. Experience designing or evaluating security architectures for traditional software applications and agent-based systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop realistic security scenarios and distinguish meaningful vulnerabilities from superficial test cases. Familiarity with deterministic testing methodologies, synthetic security fixtures, or structured evaluation frameworks is highly desirable. Excellent technical writing skills, including the ability to document security findings, testing procedures, methodologies, and actionable recommendations with precision. Strong verbal communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to review peer contributions and communicate complex security concepts clearly. Ability to work independently, manage technical tasks effectively, and deliver high-quality contributions in a fully remote environment. A proactive mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement in application security, AI security, and emerging cybersecurity practices. Benefits Competitive hourly compensation: Earn between $40 and $80 per hour, depending on experience and expertise. Fully remote work: Work remotely from anywhere in the world. Long-term contract: Initial 12-month engagement, offering

Strong knowledge of Core Java and Java SE, including object-oriented programming principles. Familiarity with Java 8 or later features, including lambda expressions and streams. jobs.title: Senior Android Developer (Kotlin)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a Senior Android Developer, you will be responsible for developing robust native Android applications while ensuring that accessibility is integrated throughout the development lifecycle. Your main responsibilities will include: Develop and maintain native Android applications using Kotlin, implementing new features and enhancing existing functionality. Build and improve application components using Jetpack Compose and/or traditional Android Views. Ensure application stability, performance, maintainability, and high code quality. Implement and optimise accessibility features to deliver inclusive mobile experiences. Ensure compatibility with TalkBack and leverage Android Accessibility APIs and Compose Semantics. Configure and improve content descriptions, accessibility roles, and states to support assistive technologies. Manage accessibility focus and navigation to provide a consistent and intuitive user experience. Support scalable text, accessible font sizes, and appropriately sized touch targets. Conduct accessibility testing, particularly with TalkBack, to identify and resolve usability issues. Validate accessibility implementations against relevant standards and support compliance with WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 guidelines. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced Android developer with strong Kotlin skills and substantial hands-on expertise in mobile accessibility. You should be comfortable developing native applications, identifying accessibility challenges, and delivering practical solutions that improve the user experience. The following qualifications and skills are required: At least 5 years of professional experience in native Android development. Strong practical knowledge of Kotlin. Commercial experience with Jetpack Compose and/or Android Views. Extensive hands-on experience implementing accessibility features in native Android applications. Strong practical experience using TalkBack. Experience with Android Accessibility APIs and/or Compose Semantics. Proven experience implementing content descriptions, accessibility roles and states, and accessibility focus management. Experience supporting scalable text, accessible font sizes, optimised touch targets, and accessible navigation. Practical experience conducting accessibility testing, particularly with TalkBack. Knowledge of accessibility standards, ideally including WCAG 2.1 and WCAG 2.2. Good English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international team. Benefits: Fully remote work model, offering flexibility in your work environment. Competitive salary. Opportunity to work in a multinational environment on international projects. Comprehensive healthcare coverage. Long-term business-to-business (B2B) contract. Stable pipeline of projects, providing opportunities for continued collaboration and professional development.

jobs.title: Mid/Senior AI LLM Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Fine-tune and optimize existing open-weight large language models to improve conversational quality, response accuracy, consistency, and personalization. Prepare, curate, and enhance training datasets to support effective model learning, reduce undesirable outputs, and improve the relevance and naturalness of generated responses. Design and implement evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and testing methodologies to measure model quality, identify weaknesses, and validate improvements. Improve conversational memory, personality consistency, and the ability of models to maintain coherent, context-aware interactions over extended conversations. Develop multilingual conversational capabilities and support interactions involving multiple characters, ensuring natural and consistent behavior across different scenarios. Investigate model failures and performance limitations, adjusting training data, prompts, model configurations, and response filters to address identified issues. Conduct GPU-based training and fine-tuning experiments, troubleshoot infrastructure and performance issues, and optimize training workflows for efficiency and reliability. Apply modern model adaptation and alignment techniques, including supervised fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, and preference-based optimization methods where appropriate. Deploy improved models into production environments, monitor their performance, analyze user-facing outcomes, and implement iterative refinements based on evaluation results. Collaborate with AI engineering, product, web development, and DevOps teams to integrate model improvements into consumer-facing applications and align technical work with product objectives. Work with sensitive conversational use cases and moderation requirements, balancing model behavior, user experience, and applicable content policies. Requirements: Proven hands-on experience fine-tuning open-weight large language models and deploying models into production environments. Strong Python programming skills, including experience developing, testing, and maintaining machine-learning workflows. Practical experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face or comparable machine-learning frameworks and model development tools. Experience with model training and adaptation techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA). Familiarity with preference-based training and alignment techniques, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) or Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Experience preparing and managing training datasets, improving data quality, and developing evaluation frameworks to assess model behavior and output quality. Practical experience with GPU-based model training, performance optimization, and debugging training-related technical issues. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate model behavior, identify root causes, design experiments, and demonstrate measurable improvements. Understanding of the challenges involved in deploying and maintaining LLM-powered applications, including response quality, consistency, inference performance, and ongoing monitoring. Experience working on consumer-facing AI products, with an understanding of how model quality and conversational behavior affect user experience. Comfort working with minimally restricted or uncensored AI models, including explicit adult or NSFW content and sensitive moderation material, while applying appropriate safeguards and content-handling practices. Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage experiments effectively, document findings, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a continuous-learning mindset, with the ability to translate experimental results into practical product improvements. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement within Europe. Long-term collaboration opportunities, with B2B co

Develop and maintain integrations with decentralized exchanges (DEXs) and aggregators, including 1inch, LiFi, and Uniswap, implementing contract-level transaction calldata, multi-hop routing, slippage management, and gas estimation. Own end-to-end transaction pipelines, from deposit detection and quote generation through trade execution and settlement, ensuring reliable processing across complex, multi-stage workflows. Improve system reliability and operational visibility by implementing structured error propagation, monitoring, alerting, and incident-triage workflows using tools such as Datadog. Identify, investigate, and resolve execution failures and performance bottlenecks, accounting for transaction reverts, retry mechanisms, liquidity constraints, gas-price spikes, and other edge cases. Solid understanding of decentralized finance fundamentals, including automated market makers (AMMs), liquidity pools, token routing, slippage, price impact, and maximum extractable value (MEV). A high degree of ownership and autonomy, including the ability to drive projects independently from concept to production, manage technical trade-offs, and take responsibility for outcomes. Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across engineering teams, share technical context, and contribute to a collaborative, remote-first environment. A proven track record of integrating with major DEX aggregators, such as 1inch, LiFi, or 0x.
